noncomputable def canonicalPacket (top : Nat) (constant : Int) (raw : List WeightedOperand)
    (test : Test) (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
  let terms := groupTyped raw
  (termsTable top terms,choosePolarity (testFormula test (termsRow top constant terms)) positive)

def ExactCertifiedLinearExit : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (zRank : Nat) (constant : Int) (raw xs : List Read),
    (∀ rd ∈ raw, rd.1.2.rank ≤ zRank) → NormalizedTape f ρ raw xs →
    (¬ ∃ rd ∈ xs, rd.1.1 ≠ 0 ∧ rd.1.2.rank = zRank ∧ NonlinearOperand rd.1.2) →
    let retained := lowerReads zRank xs
    let ops := table zRank xs
    let row := exitRow zRank constant xs
    PreparedInput ops (.atom (.nonnegative row)) ∧
    (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, OriginalSlots ν retained ∧ PreparedTableTied f zRank ρ ops ν) ∧
    (∀ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f zRank ρ ops ν →
      OriginalSlots ν retained ∧
      (∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < ops.length),
        lowerOperandRead f ρ ops[j] = some (some (ν (j+1)))) ∧
      (∀ z : Nat, PreparedTableTied f zRank (Function.update ρ zRank z) ops
          (Function.update ν 0 z) ∧
        liftedReads f (Function.update ρ zRank z) (replay zRank z xs) ∧
        NormalForm.rowValue row (Function.update ν 0 z) =
          constant + readSum (replay zRank z xs)) ∧
      NormalForm.rowValue row (Function.update ν 0 (ρ zRank)) = constant + readSum raw)

def ExactCanonicalInactiveTruth : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (constant : Int)
    (rs xs : List Read),
    liftedReads f ρ rs → (∀ rd ∈ rs, rd.1.2.rank ≤ top) →
    normalizeCanonical f ρ rs = some xs → ¬ ActiveAt top xs →
    ∀ (test : Test) (positive : Bool), test.Admitted →
      let q := canonicalPacket top constant (rs.map Prod.fst) test positive
      PreparedInput q.1 q.2 ∧
      (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν) ∧
      ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν →
        OriginalSlots ν (lowerReads top xs) ∧
        (∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < q.1.length),
          lowerOperandRead f ρ q.1[j] = some (some (ν (j+1)))) ∧
        ((q.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 (ρ top))) ↔ test.atPolarity positive (constant + readSum rs)) ∧
        ∀ z : Nat,
          liftedReads f (Function.update ρ top z) (replay top z xs) ∧
            ((q.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z)) ↔ test.atPolarity positive (constant + readSum (replay top z xs)))

about a global trace bound, nor about congruence from a sign. -/
def ExactCanonicalNonzeroTruth : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ → ∀ (r top : Nat) (s : ReadState) (xs : List Read),
    liftedReads f ρ s.reads → RankBound r top s →
    normalizeCanonical f ρ s.reads = some xs → NonzeroStop f B ρ r top s xs →
    rowCutoffCode s.constant ((xs.map Prod.fst).map encodeWeighted) ≤ ρ top →
    ∃ (a : List ActualFullLabelPairGuards.Answer)
      (anns : List Annotation) (C : Nat),
      let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
      let coef := ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata.maximalCoefficient terms a
      ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.Matches f ρ (ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.pairs
        (ActualFullValueLabels.labels terms)) a ∧
      AlignedAnnotations f ρ terms (xs.map Prod.snd) anns ∧ (fullValues f anns).max? = some C ∧
      coef = (rowParts f C terms (xs.map Prod.snd) anns).1 ∧ coef ≠ 0 ∧
      2 * stateValue s = coef * (C : Int) + 2 * (s.constant + (rowParts f C terms (xs.map Prod.snd) anns).2) ∧
      (s.constant + (rowParts f C terms (xs.map Prod.snd) anns).2).natAbs ≤
        slopeBound terms * Nat.log2 C + (s.constant.natAbs + offsetBound terms) ∧
      (0 < stateValue s ↔ 0 < coef) ∧ (stateValue s < 0 ↔ coef < 0) ∧
      (0 ≤ stateValue s ↔ 0 < coef) ∧ stateValue s ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
        test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s) ↔ test.test.atPolarity positive coef

def FullActualCanonicalTerminalTruth : Prop :=
  ExactCertifiedLinearExit ∧ ExactCanonicalInactiveTruth ∧ ExactCanonicalNonzeroTruth

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalTerminalTruth

module

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalNodeProgress
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection
open ActualReadChargeIteration (ReadState RankBound ActiveAt NodeGuards stateValue stateCharge)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping ActualCanonicalZeroTrace
open ActualZeroClassReplacement ActualMixedRowLeadingAnnotations ActualMixedRowLeadingSum
open ActualFullValueLabels ActualFullLabelPairGuards ActualFiniteFullValueGuards ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling
open ActualZeroClassCohortTransfer

/-- Outcome of the actual nonlinear branch. The finite comparison
conjunction holds at the same original valuation and real tied slots;
the maximal signed coefficient is exact, irrespective of its sign. -/
def NonlinearOutcome (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat)
    (s : ReadState) (xs : List Read) : Prop :=
  let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
  let vals := xs.map Prod.snd
  ∃ (a : List Answer) (anns : List Annotation) (C : Nat) (ν : Nat → Nat),
    a ∈ patterns (pairs (labels terms)).length ∧
    Matches f ρ (pairs (labels terms)) a ∧
    (let packet := compile top (pairs (labels terms)) a
     PreparedTableTied f top ρ packet.1 ν ∧ packet.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 (ρ top))) ∧
    AlignedAnnotations f ρ terms vals anns ∧
    (fullValues f anns).max? = some C ∧ f (ρ top) ≤ C ∧
    NodeGuards B ρ xs ∧ Ready f B ρ C terms anns ∧ TransferReady B ρ (cohort f C terms anns) ∧
    maximalCoefficient terms a = (rowParts f C terms vals anns).1 ∧
    ((maximalCoefficient terms a ≠ 0 ∧
        2 * stateValue s = maximalCoefficient terms a * (C : Int) +
          2 * (s.constant + (rowParts f C terms vals anns).2)) ∨
      (maximalCoefficient terms a = 0 ∧ ∃ out : ReadState,
        CanonicalZeroWitness f B ρ r top s out a ∧ stateCharge r out < stateCharge r s))

def ProgressAt (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (s : ReadState) : Prop :=
  ∃ xs, normalizeCanonical f ρ s.reads = some xs ∧ liftedReads f ρ xs ∧
    (¬ ActiveAt top xs ∨ (ActiveAt top xs ∧ NonlinearOutcome f B ρ r top s xs))

/-- Inactive highest stays a separate genuine alternative; no claim
about linear projection or a sign cutoff is included in this layer. -/
def ExactCanonicalLocalProgress : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (r top : Nat) (s : ReadState), liftedReads f ρ s.reads → RankBound r top s →
    (∀ xs : List Read, normalizeCanonical f ρ s.reads = some xs → ActiveAt top xs →
      let ls := labels (xs.map Prod.fst)
      NodeGuards B ρ xs ∧ ReadyFamily B ρ top ls ∧ PaidFamily B ρ top (ρ top) ls) →
    ProgressAt f B ρ r top s

def ExactCanonicalReachedProgress : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (r top : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),
    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads → RankBound r top initial → LongState initial →
    PaidGlobalTail B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) → PaidComparisonCeiling B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →
    CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers initial reached →
    ProgressAt f B ρ r top reached

def FullActualCanonicalNodeProgress : Prop :=
  ExactCanonicalLocalProgress ∧ ExactCanonicalReachedProgress

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalNodeProgress

inductive Answer where
  | less | equal | greater

def Answer.code : Answer → Nat
  | .less => 0
  | .equal => 1
  | .greater => 2

def choices : List Answer := [.less,.equal,.greater]

def Pair.maximum (p : Pair) : Nat := max p.1.rank p.2.rank

def Pair.minimum (p : Pair) : Nat := min p.1.rank p.2.rank

  (p.1.rank < top → cost B p ≤ ρ p.1.rank) ∧
  (p.2.rank < top → cost B p ≤ ρ p.2.rank)

def PaidUpdate (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (p : Pair) : Prop :=
  cost B p ≤ z ∧
  (p.1.rank < top → ρ p.1.rank < z) ∧
  (p.2.rank < top → ρ p.2.rank < z)

def ActualOutcome (f θ : Nat → Nat) (p : Pair) (answer : Answer) : Prop :=
  ∃ u v : Nat, ActualLabel f θ p.1 u ∧ ActualLabel f θ p.2 v ∧
    numericalComparison u v = answer.code

def lowerFormula : Answer → NormalForm.Formula
  | .less => .atom (.nonnegative (-1,[(1,.variable 2),(-1,.variable 1)]))
  | .equal => .conjunction
      (.atom (.nonnegative (0,[(1,.variable 1),(-1,.variable 2)])))
      (.atom (.nonnegative (0,[(1,.variable 2),(-1,.variable 1)])))
  | .greater => .atom (.nonnegative (-1,[(1,.variable 1),(-1,.variable 2)]))

def lowerPacket (p : Pair) (answer : Answer) : Packet :=
  ([.ordinary p.1.rank p.1.field,.ordinary p.2.rank p.2.field],lowerFormula answer)

def topRequest : Answer → Int × ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh.OrderTest
  | .less => (-1,.positive)
  | .equal => (1,.equalZero)
  | .greater => (1,.positive)

def topPacket (p : Pair) (a : Answer) : Packet :=
  ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh.orientedPacket p.1.field p.2.field
    p.1.rank p.2.rank (topRequest a).1 (topRequest a).2 true

/-- Same distinguished greatest raw slot throughout. A genuinely lower
pair is not evaluated at, or readdressed to, the greatest coordinate. -/
def packet (top : Nat) (p : Pair) (a : Answer) : Packet :=
  if p.maximum < top then lowerPacket p a else topPacket p a

def ExactFullLabelPairGuard : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (p : Pair), Ready B ρ top p →
    ∀ a : Answer,
      let g := packet top p a
      PreparedInput g.1 g.2 ∧
      (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top ρ g.1 ν) ∧
      ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f top ρ g.1 ν →
        ∀ z : Nat, PaidUpdate B ρ top z p →
          ((g.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z)) ↔
            ActualOutcome f (Function.update ρ top z) p a)

def ExactActualPairHasOutcome : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (p : Pair), Ready B ρ top p → PaidUpdate B ρ top z p →
    ∃ a ∈ choices, ActualOutcome f (Function.update ρ top z) p a

def FullActualFullLabelPairGuards : Prop := ExactFullLabelPairGuard ∧ ExactActualPairHasOutcome

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFullLabelPairGuards

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualShortCountCleanupChargeTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualZeroClassGuardedOneStepTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualLinearExitTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualReadChargeIteration
open scoped Classical
open OrdinalComparison OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open PreparedProjection MixedSameRankResidue
open ActualMixedRowLeadingAnnotations ActualMixedRowLeadingSum ActualZeroClassReplacement
open ActualWeightedReadNormalization ActualRankedRowColumns ActualZeroClassCohortTransfer
open ActualZeroClassRecombinedRow ActualCountOriginDispositions ActualZeroClassGroupedMovedCount
open ActualZeroClassSelectedCountKeys ActualZeroClassConcreteAssembly InnerTerminationTargets
open ActualZeroClassCommonTail ActualZeroClassOutputState ActualShortCountCleanup
open ActualShortCountCleanupCharge
open ActualLinearExit (exitRow OriginalSlots replay)

structure ReadState where
  constant : Int
  reads : List Read

def RankBound (r zRank : Nat) (s : ReadState) : Prop :=
  ∀ rd ∈ s.reads, rd.1.2.rank < r ∧ rd.1.2.rank ≤ zRank

def stateValue (s : ReadState) : Int := s.constant + readSum s.reads

noncomputable def stateCharge (r : Nat) (s : ReadState) : Nat :=
  let row := rankedRow r s.constant s.reads
  countCharge row + valueCount row

def ActiveAt (zRank : Nat) (xs : List Read) : Prop :=
  ∃ t ∈ xs.map Prod.fst, t.1 ≠ 0 ∧ t.2.rank = zRank ∧ NonlinearOperand t.2

def NodeGuards (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (xs : List Read) : Prop :=
  let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
  (∀ t ∈ terms, t.1 ≠ 0 → CountTailReady ρ t.2) ∧
  (∀ label ∈ prefixLabels terms, commonTail B terms ≤ ρ label.rank)

def ChosenClass (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (zRank : Nat) (xs : List Read)
    (annotations : List Annotation) (C : Nat) : Prop :=
  AlignedAnnotations f ρ (xs.map Prod.fst) (xs.map Prod.snd) annotations ∧
  (fullValues f annotations).max? = some C ∧ C ∈ fullValues f annotations ∧
  (∀ D ∈ fullValues f annotations, D ≤ C) ∧ f (ρ zRank) ≤ C

/-- Actual selected, guarded, strict-cleansed zero edge; not an
arbitrary lower-measure relation. The intermediate zero rewrite
and the literal short-count cleanup are on the very same witness. -/
def ZeroWitness (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r zRank : Nat)
    (source out : ReadState) : Prop :=
  ∃ (xs : List Read) (annotations : List Annotation) (C : Nat)
    (moved : List Read) (ledger : List DispositionEntry) (x₀ : Fin r) (q : NONote × NONote),
    normalizeReads f ρ source.reads = some xs ∧ ActiveAt zRank xs ∧ NodeGuards B ρ xs ∧
    ChosenClass f ρ zRank xs annotations C ∧
    let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
    let values := xs.map Prod.snd
    let ps := cohort f C terms annotations
    let anchor := leastPrefix ps
    Ready f B ρ C terms annotations ∧ TransferReady B ρ ps ∧
    (rowParts f C terms values annotations).1 = 0 ∧
    MovedAt f ρ anchor ps moved ∧ liftedReads f ρ moved ∧ AnchorAt anchor x₀ q ∧
    DisposedOrigins f ρ anchor (countOrigins f C xs annotations) ledger moved ∧
    ConcreteEquations f C r source.constant source.reads xs annotations x₀ q ledger moved ∧
    let before := outsideCohort f C terms values annotations ++ moved
    let installed := source.constant + (replaceRow f C terms values annotations).2
    ZeroClassReplacement (rankedRow r source.constant source.reads) (rankedRow r installed before) ∧
    CleanedOutput f ρ r source.constant source.reads installed before ∧
    out.constant = installed + shortShift before ∧ out.reads = retained before

structure ZeroEdge (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r zRank : Nat)
    (source out : ReadState) : Prop where
  actual : ZeroWitness f B ρ r zRank source out
  live : liftedReads f ρ out.reads
  ranks : OriginalRanks source.reads out.reads
  sameValue : stateValue source = stateValue out
  strict : stateCharge r out < stateCharge r source

inductive Trace (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r zRank : Nat) :
    Nat → ReadState → ReadState → Prop
  | nil (s : ReadState) : Trace f B ρ r zRank 0 s s
  | cons {n : Nat} {s t u : ReadState} :
      ZeroEdge f B ρ r zRank s t → Trace f B ρ r zRank n t u → Trace f B ρ r zRank (n+1) s u

def LinearTerminal (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (zRank : Nat) (constant : Int)
    (raw xs : List Read) : Prop :=
  let retained := ActualLinearExit.lowerReads zRank xs
  let ops := ActualLinearExit.table zRank xs
  let row := exitRow zRank constant xs
  PreparedInput ops (.atom (.nonnegative row)) ∧
  (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, OriginalSlots ν retained ∧ PreparedTableTied f zRank ρ ops ν) ∧
  (∀ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f zRank ρ ops ν →
    OriginalSlots ν retained ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < ops.length),
      lowerOperandRead f ρ ops[j] = some (some (ν (j+1)))) ∧
    (∀ z : Nat, PreparedTableTied f zRank (Function.update ρ zRank z) ops
        (Function.update ν 0 z) ∧
      liftedReads f (Function.update ρ zRank z) (replay zRank z xs) ∧
      NormalForm.rowValue row (Function.update ν 0 z) =
        constant + readSum (replay zRank z xs)) ∧
    NormalForm.rowValue row (Function.update ν 0 (ρ zRank)) = constant + readSum raw)

def NonzeroTerminal (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (zRank : Nat) (s : ReadState) (xs : List Read) : Prop :=
  ∃ (annotations : List Annotation) (C : Nat),
    ChosenClass f ρ zRank xs annotations C ∧
    let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
    let parts := rowParts f C terms (xs.map Prod.snd) annotations
    let R := stateValue s
    let E := s.constant + parts.2
    parts.1 ≠ 0 ∧ 2 * R = parts.1 * (C : Int) + 2 * E ∧
    E.natAbs ≤ slopeBound terms * Nat.log2 C + (s.constant.natAbs + offsetBound terms) ∧
    (SelectedLeadingSignCutoff.cutoff (slopeBound terms) (s.constant.natAbs + offsetBound terms)
        ≤ ρ zRank →
      (0 < R ↔ 0 < parts.1) ∧ (R < 0 ↔ parts.1 < 0) ∧
      (0 ≤ R ↔ 0 < parts.1) ∧ R ≠ 0)

def Terminal (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (zRank : Nat) (s : ReadState) : Prop :=
  ∃ xs, normalizeReads f ρ s.reads = some xs ∧
    ((¬ ActiveAt zRank xs ∧ LinearTerminal f ρ zRank s.constant s.reads xs) ∨
      (ActiveAt zRank xs ∧ NonzeroTerminal f ρ zRank s xs))

/-- Numerical annotation and pair-tail supply only at actual reached
nonlinear nodes and their exact normalization. No terminal or trace
existence, successful annotation, or next-node closure is assumed. -/
def ReachedGuardSupply (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r zRank : Nat)
    (initial : ReadState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Nat) (s : ReadState), Trace f B ρ r zRank n initial s →
    ∀ xs, normalizeReads f ρ s.reads = some xs → ActiveAt zRank xs → NodeGuards B ρ xs

def ExactReadProgress : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (r zRank : Nat) (s : ReadState), liftedReads f ρ s.reads → RankBound r zRank s →
    (∀ xs, normalizeReads f ρ s.reads = some xs → ActiveAt zRank xs → NodeGuards B ρ xs) →
    Terminal f ρ zRank s ∨ ∃ t, ZeroEdge f B ρ r zRank s t

/-- Fixed-assignment, actual conditional normalization. The step count
is bounded by the original exact charge, not by a supplied fuel. -/
def ExactReadChargeIteration : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (r zRank : Nat) (initial : ReadState), liftedReads f ρ initial.reads →
    RankBound r zRank initial → ReachedGuardSupply f B ρ r zRank initial →
    ∃ (n : Nat) (final : ReadState), Trace f B ρ r zRank n initial final ∧
      n ≤ stateCharge r initial ∧ Terminal f ρ zRank final ∧
      liftedReads f ρ final.reads ∧ RankBound r zRank final ∧
      OriginalRanks initial.reads final.reads ∧ stateValue initial = stateValue final

def FullActualReadChargeIteration : Prop :=
  ExactReadProgress ∧ ExactReadChargeIteration

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualReadChargeIteration

19	def ExactCanonicalReachFacts : Prop :=
20	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
21	  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),
22	    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads → RankBound r top initial → LongState initial →
23	    CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers initial reached →
24	    liftedReads f ρ reached.reads ∧ RankBound r top reached ∧ LongState reached ∧
25	    OriginalRanks initial.reads reached.reads ∧ Covers (globalAlphabet r (syntaxOf initial)) reached
26	
27	/-- One static transfer payment and the ORIGINAL long-shape premise
28	cover the actual canonical reached snapshot, not an arbitrary derived
29	syntax candidate. -/
30	def ExactCanonicalTransferFunding : Prop :=
31	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
32	  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),
33	    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads → RankBound r top initial → LongState initial →
34	    PaidGlobalTail B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →
35	    CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers initial reached →
36	    ∀ xs : List Read, normalizeCanonical f ρ reached.reads = some xs → NodeGuards B ρ xs
37	
38	/-- The original explicit comparisons and transfer ceilings are
39	separate numerical inputs. The true active highest occurrence pays the
40	greatest coordinate; the wholly linear/empty case is not forced to pay. -/
41	def ExactCanonicalReachedFunding : Prop :=
42	  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
43	  ∀ (ρ baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),
44	    StrictMono ρ → (∀ i : Nat, i < top → baseline i = ρ i) →
45	    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads → RankBound r top initial → LongState initial →
46	    PaidGlobalTail B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) → PaidComparisonCeiling B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →
47	    CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers initial reached →
48	    ∀ xs : List Read, normalizeCanonical f ρ reached.reads = some xs → ActiveAt top xs →
49	      let ls := labels (xs.map Prod.fst)
50	      NodeGuards B ρ xs ∧ ReadyFamily B baseline top ls ∧ PaidFamily B baseline top (ρ top) ls
51	
52	def FullActualCanonicalReachedFunding : Prop :=
53	  ExactCanonicalReachFacts ∧ ExactCanonicalTransferFunding ∧ ExactCanonicalReachedFunding
54

def ExactCanonicalReachFacts : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),
    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads → RankBound r top initial → LongState initial →
    CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers initial reached →
    liftedReads f ρ reached.reads ∧ RankBound r top reached ∧ LongState reached ∧
    OriginalRanks initial.reads reached.reads ∧ Covers (globalAlphabet r (syntaxOf initial)) reached

/-- One static transfer payment and the ORIGINAL long-shape premise
cover the actual canonical reached snapshot, not an arbitrary derived
syntax candidate. -/
def ExactCanonicalTransferFunding : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),

separate numerical inputs. The true active highest occurrence pays the
greatest coordinate; the wholly linear/empty case is not forced to pay. -/

  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState) (answers : List (List Answer)),

    PaidGlobalTail B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) → PaidComparisonCeiling B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →

      let ls := labels (xs.map Prod.fst)

  ExactCanonicalReachFacts ∧ ExactCanonicalTransferFunding ∧ ExactCanonicalReachedFunding

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalReachedFunding

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualReadChargeIterationTargets
public import Mathlib.Data.List.Dedup

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping
open PreparedProjection MixedSameRankResidue ActualZeroClassReplacement
open ActualWeightedReadNormalization ActualReadChargeIteration

/-- Explicit first occurrence order: List.dedup retains the last occurrence,
so reverse both before and after using it. -/
def firstKeys {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (keys : List α) : List α :=
  keys.reverse.dedup.reverse

def signedWeight {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (terms : List (Int × α)) (key : α) : Int :=
  (terms.map (fun t => if t.2 = key then t.1 else 0)).sum

def groupTape {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (terms : List (Int × α)) : List (Int × α) :=
  ((firstKeys (terms.map Prod.snd)).map (fun key => (signedWeight terms key,key))).filter
    (fun t => decide (t.1 ≠ 0))

abbrev RawTerm := Int × LowerOperandCode

def encodeTerm (t : WeightedOperand) : RawTerm := (t.1,t.2.code)

def groupRaw (terms : List RawTerm) : List RawTerm := groupTape terms

/-- This layer does not compute the guard. It takes an already available
result of checking every source occurrence, including zero weights. -/
def groupCheckedRaw (allReadsHit : Bool) (terms : List RawTerm) : Option (List RawTerm) :=
  if allReadsHit then some (groupRaw terms) else none

noncomputable def groupTyped (terms : List WeightedOperand) : List WeightedOperand := by
  classical
  exact groupTape terms

/-- All original occurrences are checked first. The ordered surviving
keys are then read at their original rank using the genuine reader. -/
noncomputable def normalizeCanonical (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (xs : List Read) : Option (List Read) :=
  if checkedReads f ρ xs then
    let weights := groupedWeights xs
    ((groupTyped (xs.map Prod.fst)).map Prod.snd).mapM (readAtWeight f ρ weights)
  else none

def ExactOperandEncoding : Prop :=
  Function.Injective LowerOperand.code ∧ Function.Injective encodeTerm

def ExactCanonicalTape : Prop :=
  (∀ (terms : List WeightedOperand),
      (groupTyped terms).map encodeTerm = groupRaw (terms.map encodeTerm)) ∧
  (∀ (terms : List WeightedOperand), ((groupTyped terms).map Prod.snd).Nodup) ∧
  ∀ (xs : List Read) (w : Int) (key : LowerOperand),
    (w,key) ∈ groupTyped (xs.map Prod.fst) ↔
      w = groupedWeights xs key ∧ key ∈ (groupedWeights xs).support

def ExactCanonicalReads : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (xs : List Read),
    (normalizeCanonical f ρ xs = none ↔ ¬ liftedReads f ρ xs) ∧
    ∀ old : List Read, normalizeReads f ρ xs = some old →
      ∃ out : List Read, normalizeCanonical f ρ xs = some out ∧
        out.Perm old ∧ out.map Prod.fst = groupTyped (xs.map Prod.fst) ∧
        liftedReads f ρ out ∧ readSum out = readSum xs

def ExactCanonicalCharge : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : Nat) (c : Int) (out old : List Read), out.Perm old →
    groupedWeights out = groupedWeights old ∧
    stateCharge r ⟨c,out⟩ = stateCharge r ⟨c,old⟩

def FullActualCanonicalOperandGrouping : Prop :=
  ExactOperandEncoding ∧ ExactCanonicalTape ∧ ExactCanonicalReads ∧ ExactCanonicalCharge

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteFullValueGuardsTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxChargeBudgetTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualFullValueLabels (Label operandLabel labels)
open ActualFiniteFullValueGuards (familyCost ReadyFamily PaidFamily)
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (syntaxOf globalAlphabet PaidGlobalTail LongState)
open ActualZeroEdgeAlphabet (expandSteps)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget)
open ActualReadChargeIteration (ReadState Trace ActiveAt NodeGuards)
open ActualZeroClassReplacement (Read liftedReads)
open ActualWeightedReadNormalization (normalizeReads)

def alphabetLabels (ops : List LowerOperand) : List Label := ops.filterMap operandLabel

def onAlphabet (B : Nat) (ops : List LowerOperand) : Nat := familyCost B (alphabetLabels ops)

noncomputable def budgetAlphabet (depth : Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand) : List LowerOperand :=
  (List.range (depth+1)).flatMap (fun n => expandSteps n (ts.map Prod.snd))

/-- One finite syntax-derived comparison cost over every ordered label
pair in the sufficient source alphabet; impossible candidates are not
asserted to be real fields. -/
noncomputable def comparisonCeiling (B r : Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand) : Nat :=
  onAlphabet B (budgetAlphabet (syntaxBudget r ts) ts)

def PaidComparisonCeiling (B r : Nat) (ρ : Nat → Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand) : Prop :=
  ∀ t ∈ ts, comparisonCeiling B r ts ≤ ρ t.2.rank

def ExactAlphabetComparisonDominance : Prop :=
  (∀ (B : Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand) (alphabet : List LowerOperand),
    (∀ t ∈ ts, t.2 ∈ alphabet) → familyCost B (labels ts) ≤ onAlphabet B alphabet) ∧
  ∀ (B r : Nat) (ts : List WeightedOperand),
    onAlphabet B (globalAlphabet r ts) ≤ comparisonCeiling B r ts

/-- The read state and reachability are genuine, not an arbitrary
symbolic tree. An actual active highest occurrence pays the greatest
bound at an original active rank; no empty-source top payment is
invented. Lower baseline values may agree only below that rank. -/
def ExactReachedComparisonFamily : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top n : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState),
    StrictMono ρ → (∀ i : Nat, i < top → baseline i = ρ i) →
    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads →
    (∀ t ∈ syntaxOf initial, t.2.rank ≤ top) →
    PaidComparisonCeiling B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →
    Trace f B ρ r top n initial reached →
    ∀ xs : List Read, normalizeReads f ρ reached.reads = some xs → ActiveAt top xs →
      NodeGuards B ρ xs →
      let ls := labels (xs.map Prod.fst)
      ReadyFamily B baseline top ls ∧ PaidFamily B baseline top (ρ top) ls

def ExactCombinedReachedComparisonSupply : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top n : Nat) (initial reached : ReadState),
    StrictMono ρ → (∀ i : Nat, i < top → baseline i = ρ i) →
    liftedReads f ρ initial.reads → LongState initial →
    (∀ t ∈ syntaxOf initial, t.2.rank ≤ top) →
    PaidGlobalTail B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →
    PaidComparisonCeiling B r ρ (syntaxOf initial) →
    Trace f B ρ r top n initial reached →
    ∀ xs : List Read, normalizeReads f ρ reached.reads = some xs → ActiveAt top xs →
      let ls := labels (xs.map Prod.fst)
      NodeGuards B ρ xs ∧ ReadyFamily B baseline top ls ∧ PaidFamily B baseline top (ρ top) ls

def FullActualGlobalComparisonCeiling : Prop :=
  ExactAlphabetComparisonDominance ∧ ExactReachedComparisonFamily ∧ ExactCombinedReachedComparisonSupply

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling

  exact (h.ranks rd here).2

    (h : RunContext f B baseline r top z initial) :

    (h : RunContext f B baseline r top z initial) :

    (h : RunContext f B baseline r top z initial) :
    PaidComparisonCeiling B r (extend baseline top z) (syntaxOf initial) := by
  intro t used

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemanticsTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemanticsContextProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualWeightedReadNormalizationActualProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankedNormalizationSyntaxSkeletonProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGlobalComparisonCeilingTraceProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteFullValueGuardsProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranchProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranchSupportProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessorProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualTraceSignCutoffProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (extend normalizedTerms exactNormalizedTermSkeleton)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds)
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (syntaxOf)
open ActualReadChargeIteration (stateValue ActiveAt NodeGuards)
open ActualZeroClassReplacement (Read liftedReads)
open ActualWeightedReadNormalization (exactNormalizedReads)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch (nodeLabels nodePacket StaticActive StaticGuards NodeResult
  exactFiniteSignedNodeBranch readTransport matchedTransport nodeCoefficient)
open ActualFiniteFullValueGuards (ReadyFamily PaidFamily exactFiniteFullValueGuards)
open ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling (exactCombinedReachedComparisonSupply)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (exactActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor)
open ActualTraceSignCutoff (exactReachedCutoffDominance)
open ActualMixedRowLeadingSum (rowCutoffCode)
open MixedSameRankResidue (encodeWeighted)
open SignedRowGuardedTest (Test)

private theorem sameTest (R coef : Int) (coefNZ : coef ≠ 0)
    (sign : (0 < R ↔ 0 < coef) ∧ (R < 0 ↔ coef < 0) ∧ (0 ≤ R ↔ 0 < coef) ∧ R ≠ 0)
    (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    test.test.atPolarity positive R ↔ test.test.atPolarity positive coef := by
  have actual : test.test.Holds R ↔ test.test.Holds coef := by
    cases test with
    | equalZero =>
        exact ⟨fun impossible => False.elim (sign.2.2.2 impossible),
          fun impossible => False.elim (coefNZ impossible)⟩
    | nonnegative =>
        change 0 ≤ R ↔ 0 ≤ coef
        rw [sign.2.2.1]
        omega
    | positive => exact sign.1
  cases positive with
  | false => exact not_congr actual
  | true => exact actual

theorem exactReachedNonlinearRoute : ExactReachedNonlinearRoute := by
  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx n s path active
  let θ := extend baseline top z
  let raw := syntaxOf s
  have rootReady := contextExtension ctx
  have below := contextBelow baseline top z
  obtain ⟨live,ranks⟩ := reachedLiveAndRank path (sourceLive ctx) ctx.ranks
  have scope : ∀ t ∈ raw, t.2.rank < r ∧ t.2.rank ≤ top := by
    intro t h
    obtain ⟨rd,atSource,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    exact ranks rd atSource
  obtain ⟨xs,normal,_,_,_,_,_⟩ := (exactNormalizedReads f θ s.reads).2 live
  have frames : xs.map Prod.fst = normalizedTerms raw := exactNormalizedTermSkeleton.1 _ _ _ _ normal
  have activeAt : ActiveAt top xs := by
    simpa only [ActiveAt,StaticActive,frames] using active
  obtain ⟨current,ready,paid⟩ := exactCombinedReachedComparisonSupply f B ctx.chosen θ baseline
    r top n initial s rootReady.1 below (sourceLive ctx) ctx.long (initialScope ctx)
    (paidTransfer ctx) (paidComparison ctx) path xs normal activeAt
  have guards : StaticGuards B θ raw := by simpa only [NodeGuards,StaticGuards,frames] using current
  have readyHere : ReadyFamily B baseline top (nodeLabels raw) := by
    simpa only [nodeLabels,frames] using ready
  have paidHere : PaidFamily B baseline top z (nodeLabels raw) := by
    have atTop : θ top = z := rootReady.2.1
    rw [atTop] at paid
    simpa only [nodeLabels,frames] using paid
  have available := exactFiniteFullValueGuards f B ctx.chosen baseline top (nodeLabels raw) readyHere
  have rawLive : liftedReads f (Function.update baseline top z) s.reads :=
    (readTransport f θ (Function.update baseline top z) top rootReady.2.2
      s.reads (fun rd h => (ranks rd h).2)).mp live
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a,member,_,ν,tied,passes⟩ := available.2 z paidHere
    exact ⟨a,member,ν,tied,passes⟩
  · intro a member passing
    obtain ⟨ν,tied,accepts⟩ := passing
    have actual := (exactFiniteSignedNodeBranch f B ctx.chosen baseline r top s.constant raw
      ctx.lower scope active readyHere a member).2.2 ν tied z ctx.above paidHere guards
      s.reads rfl rawLive accepts
    have rawMatch := ((available.1 a member).2.2 ν tied z paidHere).mp accepts
    have matchHere := (matchedTransport f θ (Function.update baseline top z) top rootReady.2.2
      (nodeLabels raw) (fun l used => (readyHere.1 l used).1) a).mpr rawMatch
    have actualResult : NodeResult f B θ r top z s raw a := by
      cases s <;> exact actual
    rcases actualResult with ⟨zero,out,edge⟩ | ⟨nonzero,_,signed⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨zero,out,edge,exactActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor f B ctx.chosen θ r top
        s out raw a rfl edge matchHere⟩
    · have origin := (exactReachedCutoffDominance f B θ r top n initial s path xs normal).2
      have now : rowCutoffCode s.constant ((normalizedTerms raw).map encodeWeighted) ≤ z := by
        rw [← frames]
        exact origin.trans ctx.signTail
      exact Or.inr ⟨nonzero,fun test positive =>
        sameTest (stateValue s) (nodeCoefficient raw a) nonzero (signed now) test positive⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics

theorem exactBoundedSignedRouteSoundness : ExactBoundedSignedRouteSoundness := by
  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx test positive fuel

@[expose] public section

open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Route routes RouteHolds signedRoute prefixGuard linearRoute
  exactTypedRouteLayout exactPathLocalAvailability)

open ActualReadChargeIteration (stateValue stateCharge Trace)
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (syntaxOf)

theorem exactBoundedSignedRouteCompleteness : ExactBoundedSignedRouteCompleteness := by
  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx test positive fuel
  induction fuel using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h fuel ih =>
      intro n s path enough valid
      by_cases active : StaticActive top (syntaxOf s)
      · have facts := exactReachedNonlinearRoute f B baseline r top z initial ctx n s path active
        obtain ⟨a,listed,passing⟩ := facts.1
        have result := facts.2 a listed passing
        rcases result with ⟨zero,out,edge,literal⟩ | ⟨nonzero,sign⟩
        · let k := fuel-1
          have decreases := edge.strict
          have depth : fuel = k+1 := by dsimp [k]; omega
          have smaller : k < fuel := by omega
          have paid : stateCharge r out ≤ k := by dsimp [k]; omega
          have childTruth : test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue out) := by
            rwa [← edge.sameValue]
          obtain ⟨child,atChild,childPasses⟩ :=
            ih k smaller (n+1) out (snoc path edge) paid childTruth
          let route := prefixGuard (nodePacket (syntaxOf s) top a) child
          have chosen : route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s) :=
            (exactTypedRouteLayout top fuel test positive (stateSyntax s) route).mpr
              (Or.inr ⟨active,a,listed,Or.inr ⟨zero,k,stateSyntax out,depth,literal,child,atChild,rfl⟩⟩)
          exact ⟨route,chosen,(exactPathLocalAvailability f baseline top z test positive
            (nodePacket (syntaxOf s) top a) child).mpr ⟨passing,childPasses⟩⟩
        · let route := signedRoute top (stateSyntax s) a
          have chosen : route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s) :=
            (exactTypedRouteLayout top fuel test positive (stateSyntax s) route).mpr
              (Or.inr ⟨active,a,listed,Or.inl ⟨nonzero,rfl⟩⟩)
          refine ⟨route,chosen,?_,(sign test positive).mp valid⟩
          intro p used
          have eq : p = nodePacket (syntaxOf s) top a := List.mem_singleton.mp used
          simpa only [eq] using passing
      · let route := linearRoute top test positive (stateSyntax s)
        have chosen : route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s) :=
          (exactTypedRouteLayout top fuel test positive (stateSyntax s) route).mpr
            (Or.inl ⟨active,rfl⟩)
        exact ⟨route,chosen,(exactReachedLinearRoute f B baseline r top z initial ctx n s path
          active test positive).mpr valid⟩

theorem exactActualSufficientSignedRoutes : ExactActualSufficientSignedRoutes := by
  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx test positive
  let fuel := syntaxBudget r (syntaxOf initial)
  let path : Trace f B (ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax.extend baseline top z) r top 0 initial initial :=
    .nil initial

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalNode
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (RawTerm encodeTerm groupRaw groupCheckedRaw groupTyped)
open ActualRawSignedStaticCeiling (RawSyntax encodeSyntax)
open ActualRawCanonicalNodeMetadata (classFlagsCode)
open ActualRawCanonicalNodeCoefficient (coefficientCode)
open ActualRawCanonicalNodeDecorator (decorateCode)
open ActualRawMarkedZeroSuccessor (markedSuccessorCode)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata (maximalCoefficient)
open ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor (orderedSuccessor canonicalSuccessor)

abbrev GroupedArgs := Int × List RawTerm × List Nat
abbrev Args := Bool × Int × List RawTerm × List Nat
abbrev RawOutcome := Int × Option RawSyntax

def zeroBodyCode (p : GroupedArgs) : Option RawSyntax := do
  let marks ← decorateCode p.2.1 (classFlagsCode p.2.1 p.2.2)
  markedSuccessorCode (p.1,marks)

def groupedCode (p : GroupedArgs) : RawOutcome :=
  let coefficient := coefficientCode p.2.1 p.2.2
  (coefficient,if coefficient = 0 then zeroBodyCode p else none)

/-- The external all-reads-hit report is not checked by this syntax
program. A rejected source (none), accepted nonzero node (some with
its coefficient and no successor), and zero node with failed body
(some with zero coefficient and no successor) are distinct. -/
def nodeCode (p : Args) : Option RawOutcome := do
  let tape ← groupCheckedRaw p.1 p.2.2.1
  pure (groupedCode (p.2.1,tape,p.2.2.2))

def ExactRawNodeBranches : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Int) (ts : List RawTerm) (answers : List Nat),
    nodeCode (false,c,ts,answers) = none ∧
    nodeCode (true,c,ts,answers) = some (groupedCode (c,groupRaw ts,answers)) ∧
    ∀ v : Int, coefficientCode (groupRaw ts) answers = v → v ≠ 0 →
      nodeCode (true,c,ts,answers) = some (v,none)

def ExactRawOrderedNode : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Int) (ts : List WeightedOperand) (answers : List Answer),
    groupedCode (c,ts.map encodeTerm,answers.map Answer.code) =
      (maximalCoefficient ts answers,(orderedSuccessor c ts answers).map encodeSyntax)

def ExactRawCanonicalNode : Prop :=
  ∀ (allReadsHit : Bool) (c : Int) (ts : List WeightedOperand) (answers : List Answer),
    nodeCode (allReadsHit,c,ts.map encodeTerm,answers.map Answer.code) =
      if allReadsHit then
        some (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped ts) answers,
          (canonicalSuccessor c ts answers).map encodeSyntax)
      else none

def ExactRawCanonicalNodeEffectivity : Prop :=
  Primrec zeroBodyCode ∧ Primrec groupedCode ∧ Primrec nodeCode

def FullActualRawCanonicalNode : Prop :=
  ExactRawNodeBranches ∧ ExactRawOrderedNode ∧ ExactRawCanonicalNode ∧ ExactRawCanonicalNodeEffectivity

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawCanonicalNode

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalNormalizedTapeTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualNormalizedTapeZeroTransitionTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessorTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor
open scoped Classical
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection MixedSameRankResidue
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor
open ActualFullValueLabels ActualFullLabelPairGuards ActualFiniteFullValueGuards
open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata ActualZeroSuccessorMarkedClass
open ActualZeroClassReplacement ActualZeroClassCohortTransfer ActualZeroClassRecombinedRow
open ActualMixedRowLeadingAnnotations ActualMixedRowLeadingSum ActualCountOriginDispositions
open ActualShortCountCleanup ActualShortCountCleanupCharge ActualRankedRowColumns
open ActualZeroClassSelectedCountKeys ActualZeroClassConcreteAssembly InnerTerminationTargets
open ActualZeroClassGroupedMovedCount (AnchorAt)

/-- The syntax for one given comparison vector in the supplied order.
No f, read payload or valuation is used to render the plan. -/
noncomputable def orderedSuccessor (constant : Int) (terms : List WeightedOperand)
    (a : List Answer) : Option SyntaxState := do
  if maximalCoefficient terms a = 0 then
    let ms ← decorate terms (classFlags (labels terms) a)
    successorFromMarks constant ms
  else none

noncomputable def canonicalSuccessor (constant : Int) (terms : List WeightedOperand)
    (a : List Answer) : Option SyntaxState :=
  orderedSuccessor constant (groupTyped terms) a

/-- Erasure statement applies to the very same moved reads at the own
chosen ordered first-tie anchor, not an existential alternate move. -/
def ExactOrderedSuccessorErasure : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (C : Nat) (constant : Int) (xs : List Read)
    (anns : List Annotation) (a : List Answer) (moved : List Read),
    let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
    let vals := xs.map Prod.snd
    AlignedAnnotations f ρ terms vals anns →
    (∀ t ∈ terms, t.1 ≠ 0 → CountTailReady ρ t.2) →
    labels terms ≠ [] → Matches f ρ (pairs (labels terms)) a →
    (fullValues f anns).max? = some C → maximalCoefficient terms a = 0 →
    let ps := cohort f C terms anns
    MovedAt f ρ (leastPrefix ps) ps moved →
    let before := outsideCohort f C terms vals anns ++ moved
    let installed := constant + (replaceRow f C terms vals anns).2
    orderedSuccessor constant terms a =
      some ⟨installed + shortShift before,(retained before).map Prod.fst⟩

def ExactCanonicalSuccessorWitness : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat), StrictMono ρ →
  ∀ (C r : Nat) (constant : Int) (raw xs : List Read) (anns : List Annotation)
    (a : List Answer),
    liftedReads f ρ raw → (∀ rd ∈ raw, rd.1.2.rank < r) →
    normalizeCanonical f ρ raw = some xs →
    let terms := xs.map Prod.fst
    let vals := xs.map Prod.snd
    AlignedAnnotations f ρ terms vals anns →
    (∀ t ∈ terms, t.1 ≠ 0 → CountTailReady ρ t.2) →
    labels terms ≠ [] → Matches f ρ (pairs (labels terms)) a →
    (fullValues f anns).max? = some C →
    maximalCoefficient (groupTyped (raw.map Prod.fst)) a = 0 →
    Ready f B ρ C terms anns →
    let ps := cohort f C terms anns
    TransferReady B ρ ps →
    let anchor := leastPrefix ps
    ∃ (moved : List Read) (ledger : List DispositionEntry) (x₀ : Fin r) (q : NONote × NONote),
      MovedAt f ρ anchor ps moved ∧ liftedReads f ρ moved ∧ AnchorAt anchor x₀ q ∧
      DisposedOrigins f ρ anchor (countOrigins f C xs anns) ledger moved ∧
      ConcreteEquations f C r constant raw xs anns x₀ q ledger moved ∧
      let before := outsideCohort f C terms vals anns ++ moved
      let installed := constant + (replaceRow f C terms vals anns).2
      ZeroClassReplacement (rankedRow r constant raw) (rankedRow r installed before) ∧
      CleanedOutput f ρ r constant raw installed before ∧
      canonicalSuccessor constant (raw.map Prod.fst) a =
        some ⟨installed + shortShift before,(retained before).map Prod.fst⟩

def FullActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor : Prop :=
  ExactOrderedSuccessorErasure ∧ ExactCanonicalSuccessorWitness

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutesTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutes
open PreparedProjection
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState successor)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (normalizedTerms)
open ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch (nodePattern nodePacket nodeCoefficient StaticActive)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualMixedRowLeadingAnnotations (NonlinearOperand)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)

private theorem nonlinearExact (op : LowerOperand) : nonlinear op = true ↔ NonlinearOperand op := by
  cases op with
  | coordinate r => simp [nonlinear,NonlinearOperand]
  | count r l m => simp [nonlinear,NonlinearOperand]
  | ordinary r F =>
      cases F <;> simp [nonlinear,NonlinearOperand,SelectedNonlinearImageBounds.NonlinearField]

theorem exactActiveSyntax : ExactActiveSyntax := by
  intro top raw
  simp only [active,List.any_eq_true,activeTest,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq,nonlinearExact,
    StaticActive,and_assoc]

theorem exactPathLocalAvailability : ExactPathLocalAvailability := by
  intro f baseline top z test positive g tail
  change (((∀ h ∈ g::tail.guards, PacketHolds f baseline top z h)) ∧
      TipHolds f baseline top z test positive tail.tip) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨reads,tip⟩
    exact ⟨reads g List.mem_cons_self,fun h used => reads h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ used),tip⟩
  · rintro ⟨head,rest,tip⟩
    refine ⟨?_,tip⟩
    intro p used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with eq | more
    · simpa only [eq] using head
    · exact rest p more

private theorem branchLayout (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) (answer : List Answer) (route : Route) :
    route ∈ branchRoutes top s next answer ↔
      (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer ≠ 0 ∧ route = signedRoute top s answer) ∨
      (nodeCoefficient s.terms answer = 0 ∧ ∃ out,
        successor s.constant s.terms answer = some out ∧
        ∃ child ∈ next out, route = prefixGuard (nodePacket s.terms top answer) child) := by
  by_cases cancel : nodeCoefficient s.terms answer = 0
  · cases produced : successor s.constant s.terms answer with
    | none => simp [branchRoutes,cancel,produced]
    | some out =>
        rw [branchRoutes,if_pos cancel,produced]
        constructor
        · intro member
          obtain ⟨child,here,eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
          exact Or.inr ⟨cancel,out,rfl,child,here,eq.symm⟩
        · rintro (⟨different,_⟩ | ⟨_,val,eq,child,here,exactRoute⟩)
          · exact False.elim (different cancel)
          · have same := Option.some.inj eq

1	module
2	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacketTargets
3	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutesProof
4	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFullLabelPairGuardsLowerProof
5	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPreparedSlotAppendProof
6	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.HighFieldPreparedPacketShapeProof
7	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StableSortedHighFieldPacketProof
8	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormulaShapeProof
9	
10	@[expose] public section
11	namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket
12	open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
13	open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
14	open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet exactPreparedAppend)
15	open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest orientedPacket strictPacket equalPacket)
16	open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Tip Route routes exactTypedRouteLayout linearRoute signedRoute prefixGuard)
17	open ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch (nodePacket)
18	open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Pair Answer lowerShape)
19	open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
20	open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
21	open OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula (safeTruth safeFalsity safeTest safePolarity)
22	open StableSortedHighField (basePacket basePacketExact appendOrderShape)
23	
24	private theorem strictShape (F G : ValueField) (lo : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
25	    Shape (strictPacket F G lo c k pos) := by
26	  let base := basePacket F G lo (ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh.request k c).1
27	  have ready : PreparedInput base.1 base.2 :=
28	    (basePacketExact F G lo (lo+1) _ (Nat.lt_succ_self lo)).2
29	  exact appendOrderShape base.1 _ lo (safePolarity _ _ ready _)
30	
31	private theorem orientedShape (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
32	    Shape (orientedPacket F G i j c k pos) := by
33	  unfold orientedPacket
34	  split
35	  · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
36	  · split
37	    · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
38	    · change PreparedInput [] (OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula.choosePolarity _ _)
39	      exact safePolarity _ _ (HighFieldPreparedPacket.packetShape.2.1 _ _ _) _
40	
41	private theorem pairShape (top : Nat) (p : Pair) (a : Answer) :
42	    Shape (ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet top p a) := by
43	  unfold ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet
44	  split
45	  · exact lowerShape _ _
46	  · exact orientedShape _ _ _ _ _ _ _
47	
48	private theorem compileShape (top : Nat) (ps : List Pair) (as : List Answer) :
49	    Shape (ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.compile top ps as) := by
50	  induction ps generalizing as with
51	  | nil =>
52	    cases as with
53	    | nil => exact safeTruth []
54	    | cons a as => exact safeFalsity []
55	  | cons p ps ih =>
56	    cases as with
57	    | nil => exact safeFalsity []
58	    | cons a as =>
59	      exact (exactPreparedAppend _ _ (pairShape top p a) (ih as)).1
60	
61	private theorem guardShape (terms : List WeightedOperand) (top : Nat) (a : List Answer) :
62	    Shape (nodePacket terms top a) := compileShape _ _ _
63	
64	private theorem namesShape (n : Nat) (xs : List WeightedOperand) :
65	    ∀ t ∈ ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.names n xs,
66	      ∃ i : Nat, t.2 = .variable i ∧ i < n+xs.length := by
67	  induction xs generalizing n with
68	  | nil => intro t used; cases used
69	  | cons x xs ih =>
70	    intro t used
71	    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
72	    · subst t

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacketTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutesProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFullLabelPairGuardsLowerProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPreparedSlotAppendProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.HighFieldPreparedPacketShapeProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StableSortedHighFieldPacketProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormulaShapeProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet exactPreparedAppend)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest orientedPacket strictPacket equalPacket)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Tip Route routes exactTypedRouteLayout linearRoute signedRoute prefixGuard)
open ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch (nodePacket)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Pair Answer lowerShape)
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula (safeTruth safeFalsity safeTest safePolarity)
open StableSortedHighField (basePacket basePacketExact appendOrderShape)

private theorem strictShape (F G : ValueField) (lo : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
    Shape (strictPacket F G lo c k pos) := by
  let base := basePacket F G lo (ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh.request k c).1
  have ready : PreparedInput base.1 base.2 :=
    (basePacketExact F G lo (lo+1) _ (Nat.lt_succ_self lo)).2
  exact appendOrderShape base.1 _ lo (safePolarity _ _ ready _)

private theorem orientedShape (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
    Shape (orientedPacket F G i j c k pos) := by
  unfold orientedPacket
  split
  · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
  · split
    · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
    · change PreparedInput [] (OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula.choosePolarity _ _)
      exact safePolarity _ _ (HighFieldPreparedPacket.packetShape.2.1 _ _ _) _

private theorem pairShape (top : Nat) (p : Pair) (a : Answer) :
    Shape (ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet top p a) := by
  unfold ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet
  split
  · exact lowerShape _ _
  · exact orientedShape _ _ _ _ _ _ _

private theorem compileShape (top : Nat) (ps : List Pair) (as : List Answer) :
    Shape (ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.compile top ps as) := by
  induction ps generalizing as with
  | nil =>
    cases as with
    | nil => exact safeTruth []
    | cons a as => exact safeFalsity []
  | cons p ps ih =>
    cases as with
    | nil => exact safeFalsity []
    | cons a as =>
      exact (exactPreparedAppend _ _ (pairShape top p a) (ih as)).1

private theorem guardShape (terms : List WeightedOperand) (top : Nat) (a : List Answer) :
    Shape (nodePacket terms top a) := compileShape _ _ _

private theorem namesShape (n : Nat) (xs : List WeightedOperand) :
    ∀ t ∈ ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.names n xs,
      ∃ i : Nat, t.2 = .variable i ∧ i < n+xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing n with
  | nil => intro t used; cases used
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro t used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact ⟨n,rfl,by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,bound⟩ := ih (n+1) t rest
      exact ⟨i,eq,by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega⟩

private theorem linearPacketShape (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) :
    Shape (terminalPacket test pos (linearRoute top test pos s).tip) := by
  let terms := ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax.normalizedTerms s.terms
  let low := ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.lower top terms
  let ops := low.map Prod.snd
  let row := ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.termsRow top s.constant terms
  have plain : PlainPreparedRow row := by
    intro t used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,_⟩ := namesShape 1 low t rest
      exact ⟨i,eq⟩
  have bounds : ∀ n ∈ NormalForm.rowVariables row, n ≤ ops.length := by
    intro n used
    obtain ⟨t,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,bound⟩ := namesShape 1 low t rest
      change t.2.name ≤ ops.length
      rw [eq]
      change i ≤ ops.length
      simpa only [ops,List.length_map,Nat.add_comm 1,Nat.lt_succ_iff] using bound
  exact safePolarity ops _ (safeTest ops test.test row plain bounds) pos

private theorem signedPacketShape (test : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) (coef : Int) :
    Shape (terminalPacket test pos (.signed coef)) := by
  let selected := if pos then signedBit test coef else !(signedBit test coef)
  change PreparedInput [] (if selected then .truth else .falsity)
  by_cases passes : selected = true
  · rw [if_pos passes]
    exact safeTruth []
  · rw [if_neg passes]
    exact safeFalsity []

theorem exactEmittedRouteShape : ExactEmittedRouteShape := by
  intro top fuel
  induction fuel using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h fuel ih =>
    intro test positive s path member
    rcases (exactTypedRouteLayout top fuel test positive s path).mp member with idle | active
    · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := idle
      exact ⟨fun p used => False.elim (List.not_mem_nil used),linearPacketShape top test positive s⟩
    · obtain ⟨_,a,_,br⟩ := active
      rcases br with tip | more
      · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := tip
        refine ⟨?_,signedPacketShape _ _ _⟩
        intro p used
        have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp used
        rw [eq]
        exact guardShape s.terms top a
      · obtain ⟨_,k,out,depth,_,tail,htail,rfl⟩ := more
        have lt : k < fuel := by omega
        obtain ⟨shapeGuard,shapeTip⟩ := ih k lt test positive out tail htail
        refine ⟨?_,shapeTip⟩
        intro p used
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
        · rw [first]
          exact guardShape s.terms top a
        · exact shapeGuard p rest

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket

namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch

theorem supported (r top : Nat) (raw : List WeightedOperand) (rs : List Read)
    (literal : rs.map Prod.fst = raw)
    (scope : ∀ t ∈ raw, t.2.rank < r ∧ t.2.rank ≤ top) :
    ∀ rd ∈ rs, rd.1.2.rank < r ∧ rd.1.2.rank ≤ top := by
  intro rd used
  apply scope rd.1
  rw [← literal]
  exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨rd,used,rfl⟩

theorem readTransport (f ρ σ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (agreed : AgreeThrough ρ σ top)
    (rs : List Read) (scope : ∀ rd ∈ rs, rd.1.2.rank ≤ top) :
    liftedReads f ρ rs ↔ liftedReads f σ rs := by
  apply (exactOriginalRankReadLocality f ρ σ top agreed).2.1
  intro t used
  obtain ⟨rd,here,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used

theorem matchedTransport (f ρ σ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (agreed : AgreeThrough ρ σ top)
    (ls : List Label) (range : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.rank ≤ top) (as : List Answer) :
    Matches f ρ (pairs ls) as ↔ Matches f σ (pairs ls) as := by
  have label := (exactOriginalRankReadLocality f ρ σ top agreed).2.2.1
  have scope (p : Pair) (used : p ∈ pairs ls) : p.1.rank ≤ top ∧ p.2.rank ≤ top := by
    obtain ⟨l,hl,inside⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp used
    obtain ⟨r,hr,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp inside
    exact ⟨range l hl,range r hr⟩
  have equiv (ps : List Pair) (within : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.1.rank ≤ top ∧ p.2.rank ≤ top)

    induction ps generalizing as with

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalFundedTerminalTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalTerminalTruthInactiveProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalFundedTerminal
open PreparedProjection ActualZeroClassReplacement ActualReadChargeIteration
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping ActualCanonicalStoppingTrace ActualCanonicalZeroTrace
open ActualCanonicalTerminalTruth ActualCanonicalSignFunding
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)

private theorem linearForward (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (source stopped : ReadState)
    (xs : List Read) (live : liftedReads f ρ stopped.reads)
    (bounded : ∀ rd ∈ stopped.reads, rd.1.2.rank ≤ top)
    (normal : normalizeCanonical f ρ stopped.reads = some xs)
    (inactive : ¬ ActiveAt top xs) (sameValue : stateValue source = stateValue stopped) :
    LinearForward f ρ top source stopped xs := by
  intro test positive
  have admitted : test.test.Admitted := by cases test <;> trivial
  obtain ⟨scope,someTied,meaning⟩ := exactCanonicalInactiveTruth f ρ top stopped.constant
    stopped.reads xs live bounded normal inactive test.test positive admitted
  refine ⟨scope,someTied,?_⟩
  intro ν tied
  obtain ⟨slots,hits,current,_⟩ := meaning ν tied
  refine ⟨slots,hits,?_⟩
  rw [sameValue]
  exact current

theorem exactFundedForwardTruth : ExactFundedForwardTruth := by
  intro f B chosen ρ strict r top initial stopped answers live ranks long signPaid path stop
  obtain ⟨_,endLive,endRank,_,value,_⟩ := exactCanonicalTraceReplay f B chosen ρ r top
    initial stopped answers path
  obtain ⟨xs,normal,sourceReads,branches⟩ := stop
  refine ⟨xs,normal,sourceReads,?_⟩
  rcases branches with inactive | ⟨active,nonzero⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨inactive,linearForward f ρ top initial stopped xs (endLive live)
      (fun rd member => (endRank ranks rd member).2) normal inactive value⟩
  · have localPaid := (exactCanonicalSignFunding f B chosen ρ r top initial stopped answers
      live ranks long path xs normal).2.2 signPaid
    obtain ⟨a,anns,C,matching,aligned,maximum,coeff,notZero,equation,errorBound,
      positiveValue,negativeValue,nonnegativeValue,notZeroValue,tests⟩ :=
      exactCanonicalNonzeroTruth f B chosen ρ strict r top stopped xs
        (endLive live) (endRank ranks) normal nonzero localPaid
    have verdict : NonzeroForward f B ρ r top initial stopped xs := by
      unfold NonzeroForward
      refine ⟨nonzero,localPaid,?_⟩
      refine ⟨a,matching,notZero,?_⟩
      intro test positive
      rw [value]
      exact tests test positive
    exact Or.inr (show ActiveAt top xs ∧ NonzeroForward f B ρ r top initial stopped xs from
      And.intro active verdict)

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalFundedTerminal

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranchTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormulaTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open PreparedProjection
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualZeroClassReplacement (Read liftedReads readSum)
open ActualWeightedReadNormalization (normalizeReads)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (normalizedTerms)
open ActualFiniteSignedNodeBranch (StaticActive)
open ActualLinearExit (lowerReads table exitRow OriginalSlots replay)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula (testFormula choosePolarity)
open SignedRowGuardedTest (Test)

def lower (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : List WeightedOperand :=
  terms.filter (fun t => decide (t.2.rank < top))

def slope (top : Nat) : List WeightedOperand → Int
  | [] => 0
  | t::ts => if t.2.rank = top then t.1 + slope top ts else slope top ts

def names (i : Nat) : List WeightedOperand → List (Int × NormalForm.Summand)
  | [] => []
  | t::ts => (t.1,.variable i) :: names (i+1) ts

def termsTable (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : List LowerOperand :=
  (lower top terms).map Prod.snd

def termsRow (top : Nat) (constant : Int) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : NormalForm.Row :=
  (constant,(slope top terms,.variable 0) :: names 1 (lower top terms))

noncomputable def packet (top : Nat) (constant : Int) (raw : List WeightedOperand)
    (test : Test) (positive : Bool) : Packet :=
  let terms := normalizedTerms raw
  (termsTable top terms,choosePolarity (testFormula test (termsRow top constant terms)) positive)

def ExactSyntaxOfLinearExit : Prop :=
  ∀ (top : Nat) (constant : Int) (xs : List Read),
    lower top (xs.map Prod.fst) = (lowerReads top xs).map Prod.fst ∧
    termsTable top (xs.map Prod.fst) = table top xs ∧
    termsRow top constant (xs.map Prod.fst) = exitRow top constant xs

/-- True source read domain stays a premise. At other greatest values
only the live normalized tape is replayed, never a discarded raw read. -/
def ExactActualSyntaxLinearTerminal : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) (constant : Int)
    (raw : List WeightedOperand) (rs : List Read),
    rs.map Prod.fst = raw →
    (∀ t ∈ raw, t.2.rank ≤ top) →
    liftedReads f ρ rs → ¬ StaticActive top raw →
    ∀ (test : Test) (positive : Bool), test.Admitted →
      let q := packet top constant raw test positive
      ∃ xs : List Read, normalizeReads f ρ rs = some xs ∧
        PreparedInput q.1 q.2 ∧
        (∃ ν : Nat → Nat, PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν) ∧
        ∀ (ν : Nat → Nat), PreparedTableTied f top ρ q.1 ν →
          OriginalSlots ν (lowerReads top xs) ∧
          (∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < q.1.length),
            lowerOperandRead f ρ q.1[j] = some (some (ν (j+1)))) ∧
          ((q.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 (ρ top))) ↔ test.atPolarity positive (constant + readSum rs)) ∧
          ∀ z : Nat,
            liftedReads f (Function.update ρ top z) (replay top z xs) ∧
              ((q.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z)) ↔ test.atPolarity positive (constant + readSum (replay top z xs)))

def FullActualSyntaxLinearTerminal : Prop := ExactSyntaxOfLinearExit ∧ ExactActualSyntaxLinearTerminal

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal

noncomputable def normalizedTerms (terms : List WeightedOperand) : List WeightedOperand :=
  let weights := syntaxWeights terms
  weights.support.toList.map (fun op => (weights op,op))

def LowerStrict (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Nat, i < j → j < top → ρ i < ρ j

def AboveLower (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Nat, i < top → ρ i < z

/-- Strictly extend above the actual active rank support. This is not
the old raw update at unrelated, unused coordinates beyond top. -/
def extend (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if i < top then ρ i else z + (i-top)

def AgreeThrough (ρ σ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Nat, i ≤ top → ρ i = σ i

def ExactNormalizedTermSkeleton : Prop :=
  (∀ (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (source xs : List Read), normalizeReads f ρ source = some xs →
    xs.map Prod.fst = normalizedTerms (source.map Prod.fst)) ∧
  ∀ (terms : List WeightedOperand) (t : WeightedOperand), t ∈ normalizedTerms terms →
    t.1 ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ u ∈ terms, u.2 = t.2

def ExactOriginalSupportRankExtension : Prop :=
  ∀ (ρ : Nat → Nat) (top z : Nat), LowerStrict ρ top → AboveLower ρ top z →
    StrictMono (extend ρ top z) ∧ extend ρ top z top = z ∧
      AgreeThrough (extend ρ top z) (Function.update ρ top z) top

def ExactOriginalRankReadLocality : Prop :=
  ∀ (f ρ σ : Nat → Nat) (top : Nat), AgreeThrough ρ σ top →
    (∀ op : LowerOperand, op.rank ≤ top →
      lowerOperandRead f ρ op = lowerOperandRead f σ op ∧
        ∀ v : Nat, LowerOperandActual f ρ op v ↔ LowerOperandActual f σ op v) ∧
    (∀ terms : List WeightedOperand, (∀ t ∈ terms, t.2.rank ≤ top) →
      ∀ vs : List Nat, orderedReads f ρ terms vs ↔ orderedReads f σ terms vs) ∧
    (∀ (l : Label), l.rank ≤ top → ∀ v : Nat, ActualLabel f ρ l v ↔ ActualLabel f σ l v) ∧
    ∀ (ops : List LowerOperand) (ν : Nat → Nat),
      PreparedTableTied f top ρ ops ν ↔ PreparedTableTied f top σ ops ν

def FullActualRankedNormalizationSyntax : Prop :=
  ExactNormalizedTermSkeleton ∧ ExactOriginalSupportRankExtension ∧ ExactOriginalRankReadLocality

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax

1	module
2	public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemanticsTargets
3	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemanticsContextProof
4	import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxLinearTerminalProof
5	
6	@[expose] public section
7	namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics
8	open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (extend)
9	open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds RouteHolds linearRoute)
10	open ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal (packet exactActualSyntaxLinearTerminal)
11	open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (syntaxOf)
12	open ActualReadChargeIteration (stateValue)
13	open PreparedProjection
14	
15	theorem exactReachedLinearRoute : ExactReachedLinearRoute := by
16	  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx n s path inactive test positive
17	  let θ := extend baseline top z
18	  let raw := syntaxOf s
19	  let q := packet top s.constant raw test.test positive
20	  obtain ⟨live,ranks⟩ := reachedLiveAndRank path (sourceLive ctx) ctx.ranks
21	  have scope (t) (h : t ∈ raw) : t.2.rank ≤ top := by
22	    obtain ⟨rd,read,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
23	    exact (ranks rd read).2
24	  have admitted : test.test.Admitted := by cases test <;> trivial
25	  obtain ⟨xs,_,_,supplies,checks⟩ :=
26	    exactActualSyntaxLinearTerminal f θ top s.constant raw s.reads rfl scope live inactive test.test positive admitted
27	  have topValue : θ top = z := (contextExtension ctx).2.1
28	  have fit (ν : Nat → Nat) :
29	      PreparedTableTied f top baseline q.1 ν ↔ PreparedTableTied f top θ q.1 ν :=
30	    tiedBelow f baseline θ top q.1 ν (contextBelow baseline top z)
31	  have real (ν : Nat → Nat) (tied : PreparedTableTied f top θ q.1 ν) :

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemanticsTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemanticsContextProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSyntaxLinearTerminalProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (extend)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (PacketHolds RouteHolds linearRoute)
open ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal (packet exactActualSyntaxLinearTerminal)
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (syntaxOf)
open ActualReadChargeIteration (stateValue)
open PreparedProjection

theorem exactReachedLinearRoute : ExactReachedLinearRoute := by
  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx n s path inactive test positive
  let θ := extend baseline top z
  let raw := syntaxOf s
  let q := packet top s.constant raw test.test positive
  obtain ⟨live,ranks⟩ := reachedLiveAndRank path (sourceLive ctx) ctx.ranks
  have scope (t) (h : t ∈ raw) : t.2.rank ≤ top := by
    obtain ⟨rd,read,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    exact (ranks rd read).2
  have admitted : test.test.Admitted := by cases test <;> trivial
  obtain ⟨xs,_,_,supplies,checks⟩ :=
    exactActualSyntaxLinearTerminal f θ top s.constant raw s.reads rfl scope live inactive test.test positive admitted
  have topValue : θ top = z := (contextExtension ctx).2.1
  have fit (ν : Nat → Nat) :
      PreparedTableTied f top baseline q.1 ν ↔ PreparedTableTied f top θ q.1 ν :=
    tiedBelow f baseline θ top q.1 ν (contextBelow baseline top z)
  have real (ν : Nat → Nat) (tied : PreparedTableTied f top θ q.1 ν) :
      q.2.eval (Function.update ν 0 z) ↔ test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s) := by
    have actual := (checks ν tied).2.2.1
    rw [topValue] at actual
    exact actual
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,ν,tied,passes⟩
    exact (real ν ((fit ν).mp tied)).mp passes
  · intro valid
    obtain ⟨ν,tied⟩ := supplies
    exact ⟨fun g used => False.elim (List.not_mem_nil used),
      ν,(fit ν).mpr tied,(real ν tied).mpr valid⟩

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics

private theorem nodeLayout (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) (route : Route) :

      (¬ StaticActive top s.terms ∧ route = linearRoute top test positive s) ∨
      (StaticActive top s.terms ∧ ∃ a ∈ nodePattern s.terms, route ∈ branchRoutes top s next a) := by

theorem exactOriginalSignedRoutesAcrossReplay : ExactOriginalSignedRoutesAcrossReplay := by
  intro f B selected r top baseline s setup z minimum test positive
  obtain ⟨ex,ready⟩ := exactActualReplayContext f B selected r top baseline s setup z minimum
  have actual (original : ReadState) (frames : stateSyntax original = s)
      (live : ActualZeroClassReplacement.liftedReads f (Function.update baseline top z) original.reads) :
      (test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue original) ↔
        ∃ path ∈ routes top test positive (syntaxBudget r s.terms) s,
          RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive path) := by
    have known := exactActualSufficientSignedRoutes f B baseline r top z original
      (ready original frames live) test positive
    have terms : syntaxOf original = s.terms := congrArg SyntaxState.terms frames
    rw [terms,frames] at known
    exact known
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨source,frames,live,sign⟩
    exact (actual source frames live).mp sign
  · intro someRoute
    obtain ⟨original,frames,live⟩ := ex
    exact ⟨original,frames,live,(actual original frames live).mpr someRoute⟩

theorem exactSignCutoffFromSyntax : ExactSignCutoffFromSyntax := by
  intro r s
  have sameSyntax : syntaxOf (dummy (stateSyntax s)) = syntaxOf s := dummySyntax (stateSyntax s)

  have sameConstant : (dummy (stateSyntax s)).constant = s.constant := rfl
  simp only [terminalCutoffCeiling,constantCeiling,stepCeiling,massCeiling,sameSyntax,sameMass,sameConstant]

private theorem above {B r top : Nat} {baseline : Nat → Nat} {s : SyntaxState}
    (setup : LowerSetup B r top baseline s) {z : Nat}
    (minimum : replayMinimum B r top baseline s ≤ z) : AboveLower baseline top z := by
  intro i below
  have htop : top ≠ 0 := by omega
  have previous : (if top = 0 then 0 else baseline (top-1)+1) = baseline (top-1)+1 := if_neg htop
  have bound : baseline (top-1) + 1 ≤ z := by
    rw [← previous]
