module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualCanonicalFundedTerminalTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemanticsTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacketTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidSignedRouteReplayTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes
open OrdinalComparison PreparedProjection
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand encodeWeighted)
open ActualMixedRowLeadingAnnotations (NonlinearOperand)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (groupTyped)
open ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor (canonicalSuccessor)
open ActualCanonicalTerminalTruth (canonicalPacket)
open ActualCanonicalZeroTrace (CanonicalTrace CanonicalZeroWitness)
open ActualFullValueLabels (labels)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Pair Answer)
open ActualFiniteFullValueGuards (pairs patterns compile Matches)
open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata (maximalCoefficient)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape terminalPacket)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Tip Route PacketHolds RouteHolds prefixGuard)
open ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics (RunContext stateSyntax)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (extend)
open ActualReadChargeIteration (ReadState stateValue stateCharge)
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (syntaxOf)
open ActualEffectiveTerminalSignBound (inputSignBoundCode)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget)
open ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay (LowerSetup replayMinimum SourceHolds)

/-- A nonlinear occurrence with nonzero grouped coefficient at the greatest
rank, read on the first-occurrence grouping of the literal term list. This
is a property of syntax only. -/
def CanonicalActive (top : Nat) (terms : List WeightedOperand) : Prop :=
  ∃ t ∈ groupTyped terms, t.1 ≠ 0 ∧ t.2.rank = top ∧ NonlinearOperand t.2

/-- Every ternary answer tape of the node's own pair width; `grouped` is
the already grouped term list. -/
def tapes (grouped : List WeightedOperand) : List (List Answer) :=
  patterns (pairs (labels grouped)).length

/-- The comparison guard of one answer tape on the grouped label order. -/
def guard (top : Nat) (grouped : List WeightedOperand) (a : List Answer) : Packet :=
  compile top (pairs (labels grouped)) a

noncomputable def linearRoute (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) :
    Route :=
  ⟨[],.linear (canonicalPacket top s.constant s.terms test.test positive)⟩

noncomputable def signedRoute (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (a : List Answer) : Route :=
  ⟨[guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a],.signed (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a)⟩

/-- A zero-coefficient tape continues only through its own symbolic
successor; a nonzero tape is a leaf carrying its coefficient. -/
noncomputable def branchRoutes (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState) (next : SyntaxState → List Route)
    (a : List Answer) : List Route :=
  if maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0 then
    match canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a with
    | none => []
    | some out => (next out).map (prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a))
  else [signedRoute top s a]

open scoped Classical in
/-- Only stopped candidates are leaves: an inactive node contributes its
linear packet and has no children; an active node contributes one leaf per
nonzero tape and descends through zero tapes. A node all of whose tapes
continue contributes nothing by itself. -/
noncomputable def nodeRoutes (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) : List Route :=
  if CanonicalActive top s.terms then
    (tapes (groupTyped s.terms)).flatMap (branchRoutes top s next)
  else [linearRoute top test positive s]

/-- Fuel counts zero edges only, as in the accepted route tree. -/
noncomputable def routes (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    Nat → SyntaxState → List Route
  | 0,s => nodeRoutes top test positive s (fun _ => [])
  | n+1,s => nodeRoutes top test positive s (routes top test positive n)

/-- The accepted run context together with the one extra payment the
canonical route needs: the static sign bound of the initial syntax. -/
structure CanonicalContext (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat)
    (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState) : Prop where
  run : RunContext f B baseline r top z initial
  sign : inputSignBoundCode r initial.constant ((syntaxOf initial).map encodeWeighted) ≤ z

/-- What a holding guard certifies at a genuinely reached active node. -/
def RealBranch (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat)
    (r top z : Nat) (s : ReadState) (a : List Answer) : Prop :=
  (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a = 0 ∧ ∃ out : ReadState,
      CanonicalZeroWitness f B (extend baseline top z) r top s out a ∧
      canonicalSuccessor s.constant (syntaxOf s) a = some (stateSyntax out) ∧
      stateValue s = stateValue out ∧ stateCharge r out < stateCharge r s) ∨
  (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
    (test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s) ↔
      test.test.atPolarity positive (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a)))

def ExactCanonicalRouteLayout : Prop :=
  ∀ (top n : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route),
    route ∈ routes top test positive n s ↔
      (¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms ∧ route = linearRoute top test positive s) ∨
      (CanonicalActive top s.terms ∧ ∃ a ∈ tapes (groupTyped s.terms),
        (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a ≠ 0 ∧ route = signedRoute top s a) ∨
        (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) a = 0 ∧ ∃ k out, n = k+1 ∧
          canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms a = some out ∧
          ∃ tail ∈ routes top test positive k out,
            route = prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) a) tail))

/-- Shape only, for every emitted route, with no semantic hypothesis. -/
def ExactCanonicalRouteShape : Prop :=
  ∀ (top fuel : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route),
    route ∈ routes top test positive fuel s →
    (∀ p ∈ route.guards, Shape p) ∧ Shape (terminalPacket test positive route.tip)

/-- At one valuation the true answer tape of a pair list is unique. -/
def ExactMatchedAnswerUnique : Prop :=
  ∀ (f θ : Nat → Nat) (ps : List Pair) (a b : List Answer),
    Matches f θ ps a → Matches f θ ps b → a = b

def ExactCanonicalReachedLinear : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    CanonicalContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (answers : List (List Answer)) (s : ReadState),
      CanonicalTrace f B (extend baseline top z) r top answers initial s →
      ¬ CanonicalActive top (syntaxOf s) →
      ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool),
        (RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive (linearRoute top test positive (stateSyntax s)) ↔
          test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue s))

/-- Guard exactness on the canonical label order at a genuinely reached
active node: a guard holds, with its own tied lower table at the shared
greatest value, exactly when its tape is the true comparison tape of the
successful reads; some guard holds; and a holding guard has the genuine
zero edge with the literal symbolic successor, or the requested signed
polarity of the row. -/
def ExactCanonicalReachedGuards : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    CanonicalContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (answers : List (List Answer)) (s : ReadState),
      CanonicalTrace f B (extend baseline top z) r top answers initial s →
      CanonicalActive top (syntaxOf s) →
      (∀ a ∈ tapes (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)),
        (PacketHolds f baseline top z (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a) ↔
          Matches f (Function.update baseline top z)
            (pairs (labels (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)))) a)) ∧
      (∃ a ∈ tapes (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)),
        PacketHolds f baseline top z (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a)) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ tapes (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)),
        PacketHolds f baseline top z (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a) →
          RealBranch f B baseline r top z s a

def ExactCanonicalRouteSoundness : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (r top z : Nat) (initial : ReadState),
    CanonicalContext f B baseline r top z initial →
    ∀ (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (fuel : Nat) (answers : List (List Answer))
      (s : ReadState),
      CanonicalTrace f B (extend baseline top z) r top answers initial s →
      ∀ route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s),

# Paper 17: canonical signed routes — per-row guards and both directions

Key: `STAGE-CALLBACK-CANONICAL-ROUTES`. Targets module
`LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutesTargets`.

Printed source: `17-permitted-control-canonical-comparison/sections/arithmetic.tex`,
`thm:arithmetic`, subsection "A finite charge and the order normalization loop": "Normalize an order
atom by the following finite procedure … If z has no remaining nonlinear occurrence, retain the
entire row as a linear row in z … Otherwise … branch on the weak order of their full cores … A zero
combined coefficient is canceled … At a nonzero coefficient it stops by the following domination
argument." Handoff item (a): "make the emitted per-row guards characterize genuine successful reads
and the requested terminal polarity, including ordered availability, signed order/equality".

## What is stated

A route tree `routes top test positive fuel s` on the *first-occurrence* grouping
(`groupTyped`) of one signed row's literal syntax, built only from accepted canonical pieces:
`ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.compile` on `pairs (labels (groupTyped terms))` for guards,
`maximalCoefficient (groupTyped terms)` for the class coefficient, `canonicalSuccessor` for zero
edges, `canonicalPacket` for the linear exit. It reuses the accepted `Route`, `RouteHolds` and
`prefixGuard` so that `ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket.packet` renders it without change.

Only stopped candidates are leaves (see "Design decision" below).

Targets:

- `ExactCanonicalRouteLayout` — exact membership description of the tree.
- `ExactCanonicalRouteShape` — every guard and terminal is a prepared input; no semantic hypothesis.
- `ExactMatchedAnswerUnique` — at one valuation the true answer tape of a pair list is unique.
- `ExactCanonicalReachedLinear` — at a genuinely reached inactive node the linear leaf holds iff the
  requested signed test holds, either polarity.
- `ExactCanonicalReachedGuards` — at a genuinely reached active node: a guard holds iff its tape is
  the true comparison tape of the successful reads (`Matches` at the updated valuation); some guard
  holds; a holding guard carries the genuine `CanonicalZeroWitness` with the literal symbolic
  successor, or the requested polarity of the row equals that of the nonzero coefficient.
- `ExactCanonicalRouteSoundness`, `ExactCanonicalRouteCompleteness`,
  `ExactCanonicalSufficientRoutes` — some route holds iff the signed test holds, at the syntax budget.
- `ExactCanonicalRoutesAcrossReplay` — the same equivalence stated for a source syntax under the
  accepted `LowerSetup` and `replayMinimum` plus the static sign payment
  `inputSignBoundCode r s.constant (s.terms.map encodeWeighted) ≤ z`.

## What is assumed

`CanonicalContext` = the accepted `RunContext` (selection, strict lower valuation, greatest value
above it, live initial reads, rank bound, long counts, paid transfer tail, paid comparison ceiling,
paid legacy sign ceiling) **plus** `inputSignBoundCode … ≤ z`. The extra payment is real: the
canonical sign funding (#1378, #1383) is stated for it, and it is not implied by the legacy
`terminalCutoffCeiling` (the accepted dominance goes the other way). The stage bound provides it
through `rowBound`; that step is not part of this key.

## What is not claimed

- Congruence rows: untouched here. They already have one exact literal-order packet
  (`ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute.packet`, `exactGreatestCongruencePacket`).
- No `SupplierExact` instance yet: assembling these routes and the congruence packet into a supplier
  for `STAGE-CALLBACK-SUPPLIER` is the next key.
- The tree is a typed, `noncomputable` definition in depth-first order. No raw program is given and
  no claim is made that a raw program emits this order; `SupplierExact` depends on membership only,
  so a level-order raw list with the same members is what S4 has to produce.
- No statement about routes at states that are not genuinely reached from the initial read state.

## Design decision recorded before freezing (root's question)

Proper prefixes of a genuine trace: the fix is in the **list**, not in a falsity terminal. A node
contributes leaves only when it stops — its linear packet if inactive at the greatest rank, one
signed leaf per nonzero-coefficient tape if active. A node whose tapes all continue contributes
nothing by itself. Reasons:

1. Either choice needs the node's own status (active at `top`? coefficient zero?). With that status
   in hand, omitting a leaf is strictly less work than emitting a falsity packet, and it keeps the
   Cartesian join smaller.
2. One call of the accepted raw node (`ActualRawCanonicalNode.groupedCode`) returns the coefficient
   and the optional successor together, so "leaf or child" is a single case split per tape.
3. The accepted raw step (`stepCode`, `prefixes`) does not take `top` and therefore continues
   through nodes that are inactive at the greatest rank. Those continuations are not genuine
   canonical steps (`PreparedStep.active` is required), so the supplier's raw iteration must test
   activity at `top` in any case and cannot be the accepted `prefixes` list unchanged. The typed tree
   here stops at inactive nodes for that reason.

## Note for Opus B (join regression)

In these modules the join is `ActualSignedRouteCartesian.tuplePacket` over `choices`, and projection
is applied only afterwards, to `prepend top (tuplePacket …)` inside `lowerFamily`. The regression
"two rows force the greatest coordinate to be `C` and `C+1`" should be stated on the joined packet
(`PacketHolds f baseline top z (tuplePacket [p₁,p₂])` false for every `z`, hence
`LowerHolds … (project C (tuplePacket [p₁,p₂]))` false), since each row's own projected packet is
satisfiable. `StageCallbackSupplier.exactSuppliedRankedPoint` is the general statement that the
join evaluates all rows at one `z`; a concrete regression is an instance of its `mpr`-failure, and
could also be phrased through `StageCallbackSupplier.packets` on a two-row one-clause family.
`ActualLowerRankChartRows.fundRow` shows the row syntax for "coordinate ≥ B".

## State and next (end of turn 001)

**Gated:** two keys. `STAGE-CALLBACK-SUPPLIER` proves handoff items (b) and (c) once, for any
per-row packet list: if a supplier's packets are shaped and each admitted row is exact at one
greatest value under the raw row majorant, then the Cartesian-joined, projected, reified compiler
built from it has both directions of the callback and strict dimension decrease at `stageBound`, and
`HighAtStage` holds for any raw program emitting its encoded children. `STAGE-CALLBACK-LEGACY` shows
the accepted typed alternatives meet that interface and that the generic compiler then equals the
accepted `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.compile` as an ordered list.

**What this does and does not buy.** The remaining gap before `thm:arithmetic` is now exactly two
independent obligations, both stated against frozen definitions:
(1) a supplier `alt` that an executable program can emit, with `SupplierShape alt` and
`SupplierExact f B alt` — this is handoff item (a) in full (per-row guards characterising genuine
reads and terminal polarity, both directions), and it is *not* started;
(2) a computable `high` with `Emits alt B high`.
Neither is implied by what passed. The legacy supplier satisfies (1) but cannot satisfy (2).

**Ungated drafts:** none.

**Next, in order** (details in `PLAN.md`, S3–S5):
1. S3d, reading first: is `ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute.packet` already literal-order? If so the
   modular rows of the canonical supplier can reuse it unchanged with `exactGreatestCongruencePacket`.
2. S3a: guard exactness on the canonical label order from
   `ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.exactFiniteFullValueGuards`, with `ReadyFamily`/`PaidFamily` derived
   from `rowBound` for every reached canonical state.
3. S3b (completeness from #1384 + S3a) and S3c (soundness: functionality of `Matches`, and falsity
   terminals for non-stopping prefixes). S3c is the step I expect to be hardest; if the raw candidate

   new typed statement first.

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutesTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualBoundedSignedRoutesProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualFullLabelPairGuardsLowerProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPreparedSlotAppendProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.HighFieldPreparedPacketShapeProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StableSortedHighFieldPacketProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormulaShapeProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes
open OrdinalComparison FieldComparison PreparedProjection
open OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.SnyatkovCompletion
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet exactPreparedAppend)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest orientedPacket strictPacket equalPacket)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Tip Route prefixGuard)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Pair Answer ActualOutcome lowerShape)
open ActualFiniteFullValueGuards (pairs patterns compile Matches)
open ActualFullValueLabels (labels ActualLabel)
open ActualFullValueMaximalMetadata (maximalCoefficient)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (groupTyped)
open ActualCanonicalSymbolicZeroSuccessor (canonicalSuccessor)
open ActualCanonicalTerminalTruth (canonicalPacket)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape terminalPacket signedBit)
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula (safeTruth safeFalsity safeTest safePolarity)
open StableSortedHighField (basePacket basePacketExact appendOrderShape)

theorem branchLayout (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) (answer : List Answer) (route : Route) :
    route ∈ branchRoutes top s next answer ↔
      (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) answer ≠ 0 ∧ route = signedRoute top s answer) ∨
      (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) answer = 0 ∧ ∃ out,
        canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms answer = some out ∧
        ∃ child ∈ next out, route = prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) answer) child) := by
  by_cases cancel : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) answer = 0
  · cases produced : canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms answer with
    | none => simp [branchRoutes,cancel,produced]
    | some out =>
        rw [branchRoutes,if_pos cancel,produced]
        constructor
        · intro member
          obtain ⟨child,here,eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
          exact Or.inr ⟨cancel,out,rfl,child,here,eq.symm⟩
        · rintro (⟨different,_⟩ | ⟨_,val,eq,child,here,exactRoute⟩)
          · exact False.elim (different cancel)
          · have same := Option.some.inj eq
            subst val
            exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨child,here,exactRoute.symm⟩
  · simp [branchRoutes,cancel]

theorem nodeLayout (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) (route : Route) :
    route ∈ nodeRoutes top test positive s next ↔
      (¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms ∧ route = linearRoute top test positive s) ∨
      (CanonicalActive top s.terms ∧ ∃ a ∈ tapes (groupTyped s.terms),
        route ∈ branchRoutes top s next a) := by
  by_cases yes : CanonicalActive top s.terms
  · simp [nodeRoutes,yes,List.mem_flatMap]
  · simp [nodeRoutes,yes]

theorem exactCanonicalRouteLayout : ExactCanonicalRouteLayout := by
  intro top n test positive s route
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      refine (nodeLayout top test positive s (fun _ => []) route).trans ?_
      simp [branchLayout]
  | succ n =>
      refine (nodeLayout top test positive s (routes top test positive n) route).trans ?_
      simp [branchLayout]

private theorem strictShape (F G : ValueField) (lo : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
    Shape (strictPacket F G lo c k pos) := by
  let base := basePacket F G lo (ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh.request k c).1
  have ready : PreparedInput base.1 base.2 :=
    (basePacketExact F G lo (lo+1) _ (Nat.lt_succ_self lo)).2
  exact appendOrderShape base.1 _ lo (safePolarity _ _ ready _)

private theorem orientedShape (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest)
    (pos : Bool) : Shape (orientedPacket F G i j c k pos) := by
  unfold orientedPacket
  split
  · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
  · split
    · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
    · change PreparedInput [] (OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula.choosePolarity _ _)
      exact safePolarity _ _ (HighFieldPreparedPacket.packetShape.2.1 _ _ _) _

private theorem pairShape (top : Nat) (p : Pair) (a : Answer) :
    Shape (ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet top p a) := by
  unfold ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet
  split
  · exact lowerShape _ _
  · exact orientedShape _ _ _ _ _ _ _

/-- Every compiled comparison guard is a prepared input, for any pair
list and any tape, including mismatched lengths. -/
theorem compileShape (top : Nat) (ps : List Pair) (as : List Answer) :
    Shape (compile top ps as) := by
  induction ps generalizing as with
  | nil =>
    cases as with
    | nil => exact safeTruth []
    | cons a as => exact safeFalsity []
  | cons p ps ih =>
    cases as with
    | nil => exact safeFalsity []
    | cons a as =>
      exact (exactPreparedAppend _ _ (pairShape top p a) (ih as)).1

private theorem namesShape (n : Nat) (xs : List WeightedOperand) :
    ∀ t ∈ ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.names n xs,
      ∃ i : Nat, t.2 = .variable i ∧ i < n+xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing n with
  | nil => intro t used; cases used
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro t used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact ⟨n,rfl,by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,bound⟩ := ih (n+1) t rest
      exact ⟨i,eq,by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega⟩

/-- The canonical linear exit is a prepared input for every literal term
list; no read or activity hypothesis. -/
theorem canonicalPacketShape (top : Nat) (constant : Int) (raw : List WeightedOperand)
    (test : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
    Shape (canonicalPacket top constant raw test.test pos) := by
  let terms := groupTyped raw
  let low := ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.lower top terms
  let ops := low.map Prod.snd
  let row := ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.termsRow top constant terms
  have plain : PlainPreparedRow row := by
    intro t used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,_⟩ := namesShape 1 low t rest
      exact ⟨i,eq⟩
  have bounds : ∀ n ∈ NormalForm.rowVariables row, n ≤ ops.length := by
    intro n used
    obtain ⟨t,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,bound⟩ := namesShape 1 low t rest
      change t.2.name ≤ ops.length
      rw [eq]
      change i ≤ ops.length
      simpa only [ops,List.length_map,Nat.add_comm 1,Nat.lt_succ_iff] using bound
  exact safePolarity ops _ (safeTest ops test.test row plain bounds) pos

theorem signedPacketShape (test : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) (coef : Int) :
    Shape (terminalPacket test pos (.signed coef)) := by
  let selected := if pos then signedBit test coef else !(signedBit test coef)
  change PreparedInput [] (if selected then .truth else .falsity)
  by_cases passes : selected = true
  · rw [if_pos passes]
    exact safeTruth []
  · rw [if_neg passes]
    exact safeFalsity []

theorem exactCanonicalRouteShape : ExactCanonicalRouteShape := by
  intro top fuel
  induction fuel using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h fuel ih =>
    intro test positive s path member
    rcases (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top fuel test positive s path).mp member with idle | active
    · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := idle
      exact ⟨fun p used => False.elim (List.not_mem_nil used),
        canonicalPacketShape top s.constant s.terms test positive⟩
    · obtain ⟨_,a,_,br⟩ := active
      rcases br with tip | more
      · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := tip
        refine ⟨?_,signedPacketShape _ _ _⟩
        intro p used
        have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp used
        rw [eq]
        exact compileShape _ _ _
      · obtain ⟨_,k,out,depth,_,tail,htail,rfl⟩ := more
        have lt : k < fuel := by omega
        obtain ⟨shapeGuard,shapeTip⟩ := ih k lt test positive out tail htail
        refine ⟨?_,shapeTip⟩
        intro p used
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
        · rw [first]
          exact compileShape _ _ _
        · exact shapeGuard p rest

theorem answerCodeInjective (a b : Answer) (h : a.code = b.code) : a = b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (by decide)

theorem outcomeUnique (f θ : Nat → Nat) (p : Pair) (a b : Answer)
    (ha : ActualOutcome f θ p a) (hb : ActualOutcome f θ p b) : a = b := by
  obtain ⟨u,v,lu,lv,ca⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨u',v',lu',lv',cb⟩ := hb
  have eu : u = u' := Option.some.inj (Option.some.inj (lu.2.2.symm.trans lu'.2.2))
  have ev : v = v' := Option.some.inj (Option.some.inj (lv.2.2.symm.trans lv'.2.2))
  rw [eu,ev] at ca
  exact answerCodeInjective a b (ca.symm.trans cb)

theorem exactMatchedAnswerUnique : ExactMatchedAnswerUnique := by
  intro f θ ps
  induction ps with
  | nil =>
    intro a b ha hb
    cases ha
    cases hb
    rfl
  | cons p ps ih =>
    intro a b ha hb
    cases ha with
    | cons ha1 ha2 =>
      cases hb with
      | cons hb1 hb2 =>
        rw [outcomeUnique f θ p _ _ ha1 hb1,ih _ _ ha2 hb2]

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes

open StableSortedHighField (basePacket basePacketExact appendOrderShape)

theorem branchLayout (top : Nat) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) (answer : List Answer) (route : Route) :
    route ∈ branchRoutes top s next answer ↔
      (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) answer ≠ 0 ∧ route = signedRoute top s answer) ∨
      (maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) answer = 0 ∧ ∃ out,
        canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms answer = some out ∧
        ∃ child ∈ next out, route = prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped s.terms) answer) child) := by
  by_cases cancel : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped s.terms) answer = 0
  · cases produced : canonicalSuccessor s.constant s.terms answer with
    | none => simp [branchRoutes,cancel,produced]
    | some out =>
        rw [branchRoutes,if_pos cancel,produced]
        constructor
        · intro member
          obtain ⟨child,here,eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
          exact Or.inr ⟨cancel,out,rfl,child,here,eq.symm⟩
        · rintro (⟨different,_⟩ | ⟨_,val,eq,child,here,exactRoute⟩)
          · exact False.elim (different cancel)
          · have same := Option.some.inj eq
            subst val
            exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨child,here,exactRoute.symm⟩
  · simp [branchRoutes,cancel]

theorem nodeLayout (top : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState)
    (next : SyntaxState → List Route) (route : Route) :
    route ∈ nodeRoutes top test positive s next ↔
      (¬ CanonicalActive top s.terms ∧ route = linearRoute top test positive s) ∨
      (CanonicalActive top s.terms ∧ ∃ a ∈ tapes (groupTyped s.terms),
        route ∈ branchRoutes top s next a) := by
  by_cases yes : CanonicalActive top s.terms
  · simp [nodeRoutes,yes,List.mem_flatMap]
  · simp [nodeRoutes,yes]

theorem exactCanonicalRouteLayout : ExactCanonicalRouteLayout := by
  intro top n test positive s route
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      refine (nodeLayout top test positive s (fun _ => []) route).trans ?_
      simp [branchLayout]
  | succ n =>
      refine (nodeLayout top test positive s (routes top test positive n) route).trans ?_
      simp [branchLayout]

private theorem strictShape (F G : ValueField) (lo : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
    Shape (strictPacket F G lo c k pos) := by
  let base := basePacket F G lo (ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh.request k c).1
  have ready : PreparedInput base.1 base.2 :=
    (basePacketExact F G lo (lo+1) _ (Nat.lt_succ_self lo)).2
  exact appendOrderShape base.1 _ lo (safePolarity _ _ ready _)

private theorem orientedShape (F G : ValueField) (i j : Nat) (c : Int) (k : OrderTest)
    (pos : Bool) : Shape (orientedPacket F G i j c k pos) := by
  unfold orientedPacket
  split
  · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
  · split
    · exact strictShape _ _ _ _ _ _
    · change PreparedInput [] (OriginalMatrixLinearRowFormula.choosePolarity _ _)
      exact safePolarity _ _ (HighFieldPreparedPacket.packetShape.2.1 _ _ _) _

private theorem pairShape (top : Nat) (p : Pair) (a : Answer) :
    Shape (ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet top p a) := by
  unfold ActualFullLabelPairGuards.packet
  split
  · exact lowerShape _ _
  · exact orientedShape _ _ _ _ _ _ _

/-- Every compiled comparison guard is a prepared input, for any pair
list and any tape, including mismatched lengths. -/
theorem compileShape (top : Nat) (ps : List Pair) (as : List Answer) :
    Shape (compile top ps as) := by
  induction ps generalizing as with
  | nil =>
    cases as with
    | nil => exact safeTruth []
    | cons a as => exact safeFalsity []
  | cons p ps ih =>
    cases as with
    | nil => exact safeFalsity []
    | cons a as =>
      exact (exactPreparedAppend _ _ (pairShape top p a) (ih as)).1

private theorem namesShape (n : Nat) (xs : List WeightedOperand) :
    ∀ t ∈ ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.names n xs,
      ∃ i : Nat, t.2 = .variable i ∧ i < n+xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing n with
  | nil => intro t used; cases used
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro t used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact ⟨n,rfl,by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,bound⟩ := ih (n+1) t rest
      exact ⟨i,eq,by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega⟩

/-- The canonical linear exit is a prepared input for every literal term
list; no read or activity hypothesis. -/
theorem canonicalPacketShape (top : Nat) (constant : Int) (raw : List WeightedOperand)
    (test : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) :
    Shape (canonicalPacket top constant raw test.test pos) := by
  let terms := groupTyped raw
  let low := ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.lower top terms
  let ops := low.map Prod.snd
  let row := ActualSyntaxLinearTerminal.termsRow top constant terms
  have plain : PlainPreparedRow row := by
    intro t used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,_⟩ := namesShape 1 low t rest
      exact ⟨i,eq⟩
  have bounds : ∀ n ∈ NormalForm.rowVariables row, n ≤ ops.length := by
    intro n used
    obtain ⟨t,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with first | rest
    · subst t
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · obtain ⟨i,eq,bound⟩ := namesShape 1 low t rest
      change t.2.name ≤ ops.length
      rw [eq]
      change i ≤ ops.length
      simpa only [ops,List.length_map,Nat.add_comm 1,Nat.lt_succ_iff] using bound
  exact safePolarity ops _ (safeTest ops test.test row plain bounds) pos

theorem signedPacketShape (test : OrderTest) (pos : Bool) (coef : Int) :
    Shape (terminalPacket test pos (.signed coef)) := by
  let selected := if pos then signedBit test coef else !(signedBit test coef)
  change PreparedInput [] (if selected then .truth else .falsity)
  by_cases passes : selected = true
  · rw [if_pos passes]
    exact safeTruth []
  · rw [if_neg passes]
    exact safeFalsity []

theorem exactCanonicalRouteShape : ExactCanonicalRouteShape := by
  intro top fuel
  induction fuel using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h fuel ih =>
    intro test positive s path member
    rcases (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top fuel test positive s path).mp member with idle | active
    · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := idle
      exact ⟨fun p used => False.elim (List.not_mem_nil used),
        canonicalPacketShape top s.constant s.terms test positive⟩
    · obtain ⟨_,a,_,br⟩ := active
      rcases br with tip | more
      · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := tip
        refine ⟨?_,signedPacketShape _ _ _⟩
        intro p used
        have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp used
        rw [eq]
        exact compileShape _ _ _
      · obtain ⟨_,k,out,depth,_,tail,htail,rfl⟩ := more
        have lt : k < fuel := by omega
        obtain ⟨shapeGuard,shapeTip⟩ := ih k lt test positive out tail htail
        refine ⟨?_,shapeTip⟩
        intro p used
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp used with first | rest
        · rw [first]
          exact compileShape _ _ _
        · exact shapeGuard p rest

theorem answerCodeInjective (a b : Answer) (h : a.code = b.code) : a = b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (by decide)

theorem outcomeUnique (f θ : Nat → Nat) (p : Pair) (a b : Answer)
    (ha : ActualOutcome f θ p a) (hb : ActualOutcome f θ p b) : a = b := by
  obtain ⟨u,v,lu,lv,ca⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨u',v',lu',lv',cb⟩ := hb
  have eu : u = u' := Option.some.inj (Option.some.inj (lu.2.2.symm.trans lu'.2.2))
  have ev : v = v' := Option.some.inj (Option.some.inj (lv.2.2.symm.trans lv'.2.2))
  rw [eu,ev] at ca
  exact answerCodeInjective a b (ca.symm.trans cb)

theorem exactMatchedAnswerUnique : ExactMatchedAnswerUnique := by
  intro f θ ps
  induction ps with
  | nil =>
    intro a b ha hb
    cases ha
    cases hb
    rfl
  | cons p ps ih =>
    intro a b ha hb
    cases ha with
    | cons ha1 ha2 =>
      cases hb with
      | cons hb1 hb2 =>
        rw [outcomeUnique f θ p _ _ ha1 hb1,ih _ _ ha2 hb2]

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes

/-- Lifted reads have a canonical normalization whose term column is the

theorem canonicalNormal (f ρ : Nat → Nat) (raw : List Read) (live : liftedReads f ρ raw) :
    ∃ xs, normalizeCanonical f ρ raw = some xs ∧
      xs.map Prod.fst = groupTyped (raw.map Prod.fst) := by
  obtain ⟨old,oldCode,_⟩ := (exactNormalizedReads f ρ raw).2 live
  obtain ⟨out,outCode,_,frames,_⟩ := (exactCanonicalReads f ρ raw).2 old oldCode
  exact ⟨out,outCode,frames⟩

    obtain ⟨t,member,facts⟩ := activeAt
    rw [frames] at member
    exact ⟨t,member,facts⟩
  have admitted : test.test.Admitted := by cases test <;> trivial
  obtain ⟨_,supplies,checks⟩ := exactCanonicalInactiveTruth f (extend baseline top z) top

  have topValue : extend baseline top z top = z := (contextExtension ctx.run).2.1

  have rootReady := contextExtension ctx.run
  have below := contextBelow baseline top z
  have chosen := ctx.run.chosen

  obtain ⟨xs,normal,xsLive,branches⟩ := exactCanonicalReachedProgress f B chosen

    ctx.run.ranks ctx.run.long (paidTransfer ctx.run) (paidComparison ctx.run) path
  have frames : xs.map Prod.fst = groupTyped (syntaxOf s) :=

    obtain ⟨t,member,facts⟩ := active

  obtain ⟨_,ready,paid⟩ := exactCanonicalReachedFunding f B chosen (extend baseline top z)

    ctx.run.long (paidTransfer ctx.run) (paidComparison ctx.run) path xs normal activeAt
  rw [frames] at ready
  rw [frames,atTop] at paid
  have outcome : NonlinearOutcome f B (extend baseline top z) r top s xs := by
    rcases branches with idle | ⟨_,result⟩
    · exact False.elim (idle activeAt)
    · exact result
  obtain ⟨a₀,anns,C,ν₀,listed,matched,tiedAccept,aligned,maximum,floor,nodeGuards,ready₀,
    transfer,coefEq,verdict⟩ := outcome
  have stopIf : maximalCoefficient (xs.map Prod.fst) a₀ ≠ 0 →
      StopsAt f B (extend baseline top z) r top s := by
    intro nonzero
    rcases verdict with ⟨_,equation⟩ | ⟨zero,_⟩
    · exact ⟨xs,normal,xsLive,Or.inr ⟨activeAt,a₀,anns,C,ν₀,listed,matched,tiedAccept,aligned,
        maximum,floor,nodeGuards,ready₀,transfer,coefEq,nonzero,equation⟩⟩
    · exact False.elim (nonzero zero)
  have zeroIf : maximalCoefficient (xs.map Prod.fst) a₀ = 0 →
      ∃ out : ReadState, CanonicalZeroWitness f B (extend baseline top z) r top s out a₀ := by
    intro zero
    rcases verdict with ⟨nonzero,_⟩ | ⟨_,out,witness,_⟩
    · exact False.elim (nonzero zero)
    · exact ⟨out,witness⟩
  obtain ⟨tied₀,accept₀⟩ := tiedAccept
  rw [frames] at listed matched tied₀ accept₀ stopIf zeroIf
  rw [atTop] at accept₀

      extend baseline top z top := by
    rw [atTop]
    exact ctx.sign

    (labels (groupTyped (syntaxOf s))) ready
  have exactGuard (a : List Answer) (member : a ∈ tapes (groupTyped (syntaxOf s))) :
      PacketHolds f baseline top z (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a) ↔
        Matches f (Function.update baseline top z)

    · intro matchedRaw
      obtain ⟨ν,tied⟩ := someTied
      exact ⟨ν,tied,(meaning ν tied z paid).mpr matchedRaw⟩
  have holds₀ : PacketHolds f baseline top z (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a₀) :=
    ⟨ν₀,(tiedBelow f (extend baseline top z) baseline top _ ν₀
      (fun i h => (below i h).symm)).mp tied₀,accept₀⟩
  refine ⟨exactGuard,⟨a₀,listed,holds₀⟩,?_⟩
  intro a member passing
  have rawMatch := (exactGuard a member).mp passing

      (pairs (labels (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)))) a :=

      rootReady.2.2 (labels (groupTyped (syntaxOf s))) (fun l used => (ready.1 l used).1) a).mpr
      rawMatch
  have same : a = a₀ := exactMatchedAnswerUnique f _ _ a a₀ matchHere matched
  rw [same]
  unfold RealBranch
  by_cases zero : maximalCoefficient (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a₀ = 0
  · obtain ⟨out,witness⟩ := zeroIf zero
    obtain ⟨literal,_,_,_,value,strict⟩ := exactCanonicalZeroReplay f B chosen
      (extend baseline top z) r top s out a₀ witness
    exact Or.inl ⟨zero,out,witness,literal,value,strict⟩
  · obtain ⟨xs',normal',_,branches'⟩ := exactFundedForwardTruth f B chosen
      (extend baseline top z) rootReady.1 r top initial s answers (sourceLive ctx.run)
      ctx.run.ranks ctx.run.long signPaid path (stopIf zero)
    have sameXs : xs' = xs := Option.some.inj (normal'.symm.trans normal)
    rw [sameXs] at branches'
    rcases branches' with ⟨idle,_⟩ | ⟨_,forward⟩
    · exact False.elim (idle activeAt)
    · obtain ⟨_,_,a',matched',_,tests⟩ := forward
      rw [frames] at matched' tests
      have again : a' = a₀ := exactMatchedAnswerUnique f _ _ a' a₀ matched' matched
      rw [again] at tests
      refine Or.inr ⟨zero,fun test positive => ?_⟩
      rw [← valueEq]
      exact tests test positive

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes

    · exact False.elim (idle activeAt)
    · obtain ⟨_,_,a',matched',_,tests⟩ := forward
      rw [frames] at matched' tests
      have again : a' = a₀ := exactMatchedAnswerUnique f _ _ a' a₀ matched' matched
      rw [again] at tests

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes
open OrdinalComparison
open ActualZeroClassReplacement (liftedReads)
open ActualCanonicalOperandGrouping (groupTyped)
open ActualCanonicalZeroTrace (CanonicalTrace CanonicalZeroWitness)
open ActualFullLabelPairGuards (Answer)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Route PacketHolds RouteHolds prefixGuard exactPathLocalAvailability)
open ActualBoundedSignedRouteSemantics (stateSyntax)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (extend)
open ActualReadChargeIteration (ReadState stateValue stateCharge)
open ActualFiniteGlobalTail (syntaxOf)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget exactChargeBudget)
open ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay (exactActualReplayContext)

/-- A genuine canonical trace extended by one genuine zero witness. -/
theorem traceSnoc {f : Nat → Nat} {B : Nat} {ρ : Nat → Nat} {r top : Nat}
    {answers : List (List Answer)} {a : List Answer} {s t u : ReadState}
    (path : CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top answers s t) :
    CanonicalZeroWitness f B ρ r top t u a →
      CanonicalTrace f B ρ r top (answers ++ [a]) s u := by
  induction path with
  | nil s =>
      intro edge
      exact .cons edge (.nil u)
  | cons first rest ih =>
      intro edge
      exact .cons first (ih edge)

theorem exactCanonicalRouteSoundness : ExactCanonicalRouteSoundness := by
  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx test positive fuel
  induction fuel using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h fuel ih =>
      intro answers s path route member holds
      have layout := (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top fuel test positive (stateSyntax s) route).mp
        member
      rcases layout with ⟨inactive,rfl⟩ | ⟨active,a,ha,branches⟩
      · exact (exactCanonicalReachedLinear f B baseline r top z initial ctx answers s path
          inactive test positive).mp holds
      · have facts := (exactCanonicalReachedGuards f B baseline r top z initial ctx answers s
          path active).2.2
        rcases branches with ⟨nonzero,rfl⟩ | ⟨zero,k,out,depth,success,child,inChild,rfl⟩
        · have packet : PacketHolds f baseline top z (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a) :=
            holds.1 _ List.mem_cons_self
          rcases facts a ha packet with ⟨canceled,_⟩ | ⟨_,sign⟩
          · exact False.elim (nonzero canceled)
          · exact (sign test positive).mpr holds.2
        · have pair := (exactPathLocalAvailability f baseline top z test positive
            (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a) child).mp holds
          rcases facts a ha pair.1 with ⟨_,reachedOut,witness,exactOut,value,_⟩ | ⟨nonzero,_⟩
          · have eq : out = stateSyntax reachedOut :=
              Option.some.inj (success.symm.trans exactOut)
            have childMember : child ∈ routes top test positive k (stateSyntax reachedOut) :=
              eq ▸ inChild
            have valid := ih k (by omega) (answers ++ [a]) reachedOut (traceSnoc path witness)
              child childMember pair.2
            rw [value]
            exact valid
          · exact False.elim (nonzero zero)

theorem exactCanonicalRouteCompleteness : ExactCanonicalRouteCompleteness := by
  intro f B baseline r top z initial ctx test positive fuel
  induction fuel using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h fuel ih =>
      intro answers s path enough valid
      by_cases active : CanonicalActive top (syntaxOf s)
      · obtain ⟨_,⟨a,listed,passing⟩,real⟩ := exactCanonicalReachedGuards f B baseline r top z
          initial ctx answers s path active
        rcases real a listed passing with ⟨zero,out,witness,literal,value,strict⟩ | ⟨nonzero,sign⟩
        · let k := fuel-1
          have depth : fuel = k+1 := by dsimp [k]; omega
          have smaller : k < fuel := by omega
          have paid : stateCharge r out ≤ k := by dsimp [k]; omega
          have childTruth : test.test.atPolarity positive (stateValue out) := by
            rwa [← value]
          obtain ⟨child,atChild,childPasses⟩ :=
            ih k smaller (answers ++ [a]) out (traceSnoc path witness) paid childTruth
          let route := prefixGuard (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a) child
          have chosen : route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s) :=
            (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top fuel test positive (stateSyntax s) route).mpr
              (Or.inr ⟨active,a,listed,
                Or.inr ⟨zero,k,stateSyntax out,depth,literal,child,atChild,rfl⟩⟩)
          exact ⟨route,chosen,(exactPathLocalAvailability f baseline top z test positive
            (guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a) child).mpr ⟨passing,childPasses⟩⟩
        · let route := signedRoute top (stateSyntax s) a
          have chosen : route ∈ routes top test positive fuel (stateSyntax s) :=
            (exactCanonicalRouteLayout top fuel test positive (stateSyntax s) route).mpr
              (Or.inr ⟨active,a,listed,Or.inl ⟨nonzero,rfl⟩⟩)
          refine ⟨route,chosen,?_,(sign test positive).mp valid⟩
          intro p used
          have eq : p = guard top (groupTyped (syntaxOf s)) a := List.mem_singleton.mp used

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierTargets
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutesTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalSupplier
open OrdinalComparison
open StageCallbackSupplier (Supplier SupplierShape SupplierExact stageChildren Emits)
open StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes (routes)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples (MixedRow)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (packet)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget)
open OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge (compileRow)
open ActualBitFamilyRawDriver (HighProgram)
open OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery (HighAtStage)

/-- Alternatives of one compiled row. A signed row gets the rendered
canonical routes of its cleaned syntax at the syntax budget; a congruence
row keeps its one accepted literal-order packet. -/
noncomputable def alternatives (r top : Nat) : MixedRow → List Packet
  | .signed row =>
      (routes top row.test row.positive (syntaxBudget r row.source.terms) row.source).map
        (packet row.test row.positive)
  | .modular m s positive => [ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute.packet top m s positive]

/-- The canonical per-row supplier on literal bit rows. Typed and
`noncomputable`; its list order is the depth-first order of the route tree. -/
noncomputable def canonical : Supplier := fun r top row => alternatives r top (compileRow row)

def ExactCanonicalSupplierShape : Prop := SupplierShape canonical

/-- The canonical supplier meets the frozen turn-001 interface as it
stands: the raw row majorant offered there pays every canonical need. -/
def ExactCanonicalSupplierExact : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B → SupplierExact f B canonical

/-- Hence the stage contract for the canonical children. The emission
equation remains a hypothesis: no raw program is exhibited. -/
def ExactCanonicalStageCallback : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat), SelectedWithThreshold f B →
    ∀ high : HighProgram, Emits canonical B high → HighAtStage f B high (stageChildren canonical B)

def FullStageCallbackCanonicalSupplier : Prop :=
  ExactCanonicalSupplierShape ∧ ExactCanonicalSupplierExact ∧ ExactCanonicalStageCallback

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalSupplier

# Paper 17: the canonical per-row supplier meets the stage-callback interface

Key: `STAGE-CALLBACK-CANONICAL-SUPPLIER`. Targets module
`LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalSupplierTargets`.

Printed source: `17-permitted-control-canonical-comparison/sections/arithmetic.tex`,
`thm:arithmetic`, "On the all-large branch … The order normalization and every pattern guard are
linear in the greatest coordinate z. Current congruences are ordinary Presburger congruences in the
raw coordinates." Handoff: item (a) assembled with items (b) and (c).

## What is stated

`canonical r top row := alternatives r top (compileRow row)` where a signed row receives the
rendered canonical routes of its cleaned syntax at the syntax budget
(`StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes.routes`, rendered by the accepted
`ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket.packet`) and a congruence row keeps its one accepted packet
(`ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute.packet`).

- `ExactCanonicalSupplierShape` — `SupplierShape canonical`.
- `ExactCanonicalSupplierExact` — for every selected control with threshold,
  `SupplierExact f B canonical`, i.e. the *frozen turn-001 interface unchanged*: admitted row, strict
  lower valuation, ranks in the chart, every lower rank and `z` at least `rowBound`, `z` above the
  preceding rank ⟹ the literal row holds at the updated valuation iff one canonical alternative
  holds at that `z`.
- `ExactCanonicalStageCallback` — hence `HighAtStage f B high (stageChildren canonical B)` for
  every raw program with `Emits canonical B high`.

## What is assumed

`SelectedWithThreshold f B`; for the last target the emission equation.

## What is not claimed

- No computable `high` is exhibited. `Emits canonical B high` is still a hypothesis; this key does
  not close the callback or `thm:arithmetic`.
- `canonical` is `noncomputable` and lists signed alternatives in the depth-first order of the route
  tree. A raw program will most naturally produce a level order. `SupplierExact` and
  `SupplierShape` depend on membership only, so a level-order supplier with the same members
  satisfies them by the same proof; that reordering, and the raw program, are the remaining work.
- Nothing new about congruence rows beyond reusing #1245.

## Interface check

Root asked whether the canonical supplier can meet the frozen interface. It can, with no change: the
extra canonical payment `inputSignBoundCode r (cleanup s).constant (…)` is
`signCode r (encodeSyntax (cleanup s))`, which is below `staticCode B r (cleanupCode (encodeSyntax s))`
(`ActualRawSignedCleanup.cleanupCalibration`), which is the second component of `rowBound` for every
order test. The accepted `LowerSetup` and `replayMinimum` come from the same hypotheses exactly as
for the legacy supplier.

module
public import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalSupplierTargets
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackSupplierContractProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackLegacyProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutesLayoutProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalRoutesSemanticsProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacketFoldProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualGreatestCongruenceRouteProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridgeProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHighReadyProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuplesProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawSignedCleanupProof
import LogicLineages.PermittedControl.ActualRawSignedStaticCeilingProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalSupplier
open OrdinalComparison
open StageCallbackSupplier (Supplier SupplierShape SupplierExact stageChildren Emits
  exactSuppliedStageCallback)
open StageCallbackLegacy (singleNeed)
open StageCallbackCanonicalRoutes (routes exactCanonicalRouteShape exactCanonicalRoutesAcrossReplay)
open MixedSameRankResidue (WeightedOperand encodeWeighted)
open SignedRowGuardedTest (Test)
open ActualSymbolicZeroSuccessor (SyntaxState)
open ActualSignedOrdinaryPairHigh (OrderTest)
open ActualInitialSignedCountCleanup (cleanup)
open ActualRawSignedCleanup (cleanupCode cleanupCalibration)
open ActualRawSignedStaticCeiling (encodeSyntax signCode staticCode)
open ActualEffectiveTerminalSignBound (inputSignBoundCode)
open ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling (rowBound)
open ActualBitFamilyRawLayout (encodeBitRow)
open ActualPreparedSlotAppend (Packet)
open ActualSelectedSignedRoutePacket (Shape packet exactSelectedRoutePacket)
open ActualBoundedSignedRoutes (Route PacketHolds RouteHolds)
open ActualSyntaxChargeBudget (syntaxBudget)
open ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax (LowerStrict)
open ActualPaidOrderedSyntaxReads (PaidReadCeiling)
open ActualPaidSignedRouteReplay (LowerSetup replayMinimum SourceHolds)
open ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples (MixedRow Source Ready rowMinimum exactMixedMatrixMinimum)
open ActualGreatestCongruenceRoute (exactGreatestCongruenceShape exactGreatestCongruencePacket)
open OriginalPrintedTerminalBitClauses (BitRow)
open OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge (compileRow properClauses AdmittedOperandRow
  AdmittedLiteralClause properClauseMember exactLiteralMixedRowBridge)
open OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh (rankedPredecessor highMinimum OriginalSetup
  exactOriginalLiteralReady)

theorem renderedShape (top fuel : Nat) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState)
    (route : Route) (member : route ∈ routes top test positive fuel s) :
    Shape (packet test positive route) := by
  obtain ⟨guards,tip⟩ := exactCanonicalRouteShape top fuel test positive s route member
  exact (exactSelectedRoutePacket (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) top 0 test positive route guards tip).1

theorem renderedHolds (f baseline : Nat → Nat) (top z fuel : Nat) (test : OrderTest)
    (positive : Bool) (s : SyntaxState) (route : Route)
    (member : route ∈ routes top test positive fuel s) :
    PacketHolds f baseline top z (packet test positive route) ↔
      RouteHolds f baseline top z test positive route := by
  obtain ⟨guards,tip⟩ := exactCanonicalRouteShape top fuel test positive s route member
  exact (exactSelectedRoutePacket f baseline top z test positive route guards tip).2.1

theorem signedShape (r top : Nat) (src : SyntaxState) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool) :
    ∀ q ∈ alternatives r top (.signed ⟨src,test,positive⟩), Shape q := by
  intro q used
  obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
  exact renderedShape top (syntaxBudget r src.terms) test positive src route member

/-- One signed source syntax: the accepted lower setup and replay minimum
plus the static sign payment give both directions on rendered packets. -/
theorem signedExact (f : Nat → Nat) (B : Nat) (selected : SelectedWithThreshold f B)
    (r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (src : SyntaxState) (test : OrderTest) (positive : Bool)
    (z : Nat) (setup : LowerSetup B r top baseline src)
    (minimum : replayMinimum B r top baseline src ≤ z)
    (signPaid : inputSignBoundCode r src.constant (src.terms.map encodeWeighted) ≤ z) :
    SourceHolds f (Function.update baseline top z) src test positive ↔
      ∃ q ∈ alternatives r top (.signed ⟨src,test,positive⟩), PacketHolds f baseline top z q := by
  refine (exactCanonicalRoutesAcrossReplay f B selected r top baseline src setup z minimum
    signPaid test positive).trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨route,member,passes⟩
    exact ⟨packet test positive route,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨route,member,rfl⟩,
      (renderedHolds f baseline top z (syntaxBudget r src.terms) test positive src route
        member).mpr passes⟩
  · rintro ⟨q,used,passes⟩
    obtain ⟨route,member,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp used
    exact ⟨route,member,(renderedHolds f baseline top z (syntaxBudget r src.terms) test positive
      src route member).mp passes⟩

/-- For every order test the raw row majorant contains the static sign
bound of the cleaned syntax. -/
theorem signedSign (B r : Nat) (c : Int) (ts : List WeightedOperand) (bit : Bool) (test : Test)
    (order : ∀ m : Nat, test ≠ .congruence m) :
    inputSignBoundCode r (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩).constant ((cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩).terms.map encodeWeighted) ≤
      rowBound B r (encodeBitRow ((test,c,ts),bit)) := by
  have inner : signCode r (cleanupCode (encodeSyntax ⟨c,ts⟩)) ≤
      staticCode B r (cleanupCode (encodeSyntax ⟨c,ts⟩)) := le_max_right _ _
  have outer : staticCode B r (cleanupCode (encodeSyntax ⟨c,ts⟩)) ≤
      rowBound B r (encodeBitRow ((test,c,ts),bit)) := by
    cases test with
    | equalZero => exact le_max_right _ _
    | nonnegative => exact le_max_right _ _
    | positive => exact le_max_right _ _
    | congruence m => exact False.elim (order m rfl)
  have total := inner.trans outer
  rw [cleanupCalibration] at total
  exact total

/-- What the interface's payments give for one admitted row. -/
theorem rowReady (B r top : Nat) (baseline : Nat → Nat) (row : BitRow) (z : Nat)
    (admitted : AdmittedOperandRow row) (strict : LowerStrict baseline top)
    (scope : ∀ t ∈ row.1.2.2, t.2.rank < r ∧ t.2.rank ≤ top)
    (lower : ∀ i < top, rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row) ≤ baseline i)
    (high : max (rowBound B r (encodeBitRow row)) (rankedPredecessor top baseline) ≤ z) :
    PaidReadCeiling (Function.update baseline top z) row.1.2.2 ∧
      Ready B r top baseline (compileRow row) ∧
      rowMinimum B r top baseline (compileRow row) ≤ z := by
  have need := singleNeed B r row
  have setup : OriginalSetup B r top baseline [[row]] := by
    refine ⟨strict,?_,?_⟩
    · intro rows inFamily other inRows t inTerms
      have e1 : rows = [row] := List.mem_singleton.mp inFamily
      rw [e1] at inRows
      have e2 : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows
      rw [e2] at inTerms
      exact scope t inTerms
    · intro _ _ _ _ t _ below
      exact need.trans (lower t.2.rank below)
  have payment : highMinimum B r top baseline [[row]] ≤ z :=
    max_le (need.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans high)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans high)
  have clause : AdmittedLiteralClause [row] := by
    intro other inRows
    have e : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows
    rw [e]
    exact admitted
  have member : [row] ∈ properClauses [[row]] :=
    (properClauseMember [[row]] [row]).mpr ⟨List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,clause⟩
  have ready := exactOriginalLiteralReady B r top baseline [[row]] setup z payment [row] member
  have here : compileRow row ∈ [row].map compileRow :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨ready.1 row (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl),ready.2.1 (compileRow row) here,
    (exactMixedMatrixMinimum B r top baseline ([row].map compileRow) z).mp ready.2.2
      (compileRow row) here⟩

theorem exactCanonicalSupplierShape : ExactCanonicalSupplierShape := by
  intro r top row q used
  rcases row with ⟨⟨test,c,ts⟩,bit⟩
  cases test with
  | equalZero => exact signedShape r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .equalZero bit q used
  | nonnegative => exact signedShape r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .nonnegative bit q used
  | positive => exact signedShape r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .positive bit q used
  | congruence m =>
      have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp used
      subst q
      exact exactGreatestCongruenceShape top m ⟨c,ts⟩ bit

theorem exactCanonicalSupplierExact : ExactCanonicalSupplierExact := by
  intro f B selected r top baseline row z admitted strict scope lower high
  obtain ⟨paidReads,ready,minimum⟩ :=
    rowReady B r top baseline row z admitted strict scope lower high
  have literal := exactLiteralMixedRowBridge f B selected (Function.update baseline top z) row
    admitted paidReads
  refine literal.trans ?_
  rcases row with ⟨⟨test,c,ts⟩,bit⟩
  have rowPaid : rowBound B r (encodeBitRow ((test,c,ts),bit)) ≤ z :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans high
  cases test with
  | equalZero =>
      exact signedExact f B selected r top baseline (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .equalZero bit z ready
        minimum ((signedSign B r c ts bit .equalZero (by intro m h; cases h)).trans rowPaid)
  | nonnegative =>
      exact signedExact f B selected r top baseline (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .nonnegative bit z ready
        minimum ((signedSign B r c ts bit .nonnegative (by intro m h; cases h)).trans rowPaid)
  | positive =>
      exact signedExact f B selected r top baseline (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .positive bit z ready
        minimum ((signedSign B r c ts bit .positive (by intro m h; cases h)).trans rowPaid)
  | congruence m =>
      refine (exactGreatestCongruencePacket f B selected baseline top m ⟨c,ts⟩ ready z minimum
        bit).2.symm.trans ?_
      constructor
      · intro passes
        exact ⟨_,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,passes⟩
      · rintro ⟨p,h,passes⟩
        have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp h
        subst p
        exact passes

theorem exactCanonicalStageCallback : ExactCanonicalStageCallback := by
  intro f B selected high emits
  exact exactSuppliedStageCallback f B canonical exactCanonicalSupplierShape
    (exactCanonicalSupplierExact f B selected) high emits

end LogicLineages.PermittedControl.StageCallbackCanonicalSupplier

      staticCode B r (cleanupCode (encodeSyntax ⟨c,ts⟩)) := le_max_right _ _

      rowBound B r (encodeBitRow ((test,c,ts),bit)) := by
    cases test with
    | equalZero => exact le_max_right _ _

    · intro rows inFamily other inRows t inTerms

      have e2 : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows

    max_le (need.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans high)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans high)

    intro other inRows
    have e : other = row := List.mem_singleton.mp inRows

  have ready := exactOriginalLiteralReady B r top baseline [[row]] setup z payment [row] member
  have here : compileRow row ∈ [row].map compileRow :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨row,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨ready.1 row (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl),ready.2.1 (compileRow row) here,
    (exactMixedMatrixMinimum B r top baseline ([row].map compileRow) z).mp ready.2.2
      (compileRow row) here⟩

  intro r top row q used

  | equalZero => exact signedShape r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .equalZero bit q used
  | nonnegative => exact signedShape r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .nonnegative bit q used
  | positive => exact signedShape r top (cleanup ⟨c,ts⟩) .positive bit q used

  | positive =>

        minimum ((signedSign B r c ts bit .positive (by intro m h; cases h)).trans rowPaid)
  | congruence m =>
      refine (exactGreatestCongruencePacket f B selected baseline top m ⟨c,ts⟩ ready z minimum
        bit).2.symm.trans ?_

      · intro passes
        exact ⟨_,List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl,passes⟩
      · rintro ⟨p,h,passes⟩
        have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp h
        subst p
        exact passes

  intro f B selected high emits
  exact exactSuppliedStageCallback f B canonical exactCanonicalSupplierShape
    (exactCanonicalSupplierExact f B selected) high emits

# S4 survey: raw/computable forms for the emission equation (Opus B, 2026-11-22)

This is a reading survey for Fable-2's plan step S4 (`StageCallbackSupplier.Emits`). Paths are relative
to `formalization/LogicLineages/PermittedControl/` unless they say otherwise. "#N" is a record under
`verification/new-paper-set-2026-11-18/accepted/`, matched by the module's `source_pins`.
I wrote "not found" only after grepping the whole `PermittedControl/` tree, and
`OrdinalComparison/` where it says so.

## What has to be computable

`ActualBitFamilyRawDriver.HighProgram := Nat × RawFamily → List RawFamily`. `ForControl` (#1372)
asks for Mathlib `Computable high`. `Emits alt B high` is a literal list equation **for every typed
`fs` of positive dimension**, not only for reachable families:

How the proof goes (so the next reader need not reconstruct it): at a reached state, #1369
(`exactCanonicalReachedProgress`) gives the genuine outcome with *some* true tape; #1365
(`exactCanonicalReachedFunding`) pays `ReadyFamily`/`PaidFamily` on the canonical labels, so #1169's
`exactFiniteFullValueGuards` makes each guard equivalent to `Matches`; uniqueness of the true tape
then identifies any tape whose guard holds with the genuine one. Zero case: #1358
(`exactCanonicalZeroReplay`) gives the literal successor. Nonzero case: the node is a `StopsAt` node,
and #1383 (`exactFundedForwardTruth`) gives both polarities. Inactive case: #1375
(`exactCanonicalInactiveTruth`). Soundness and completeness are the accepted fuel inductions of
#1224 on this tree. (Record numbers here are from memory of the notes; root should check them.)

## 2026-11-22T21:55Z — STAGE-CALLBACK-CANONICAL-SUPPLIER: frozen, then PASS (no failed gate)

supplier *unchanged*. No new Targets module was needed for the interface. The extra canonical
payment is `signCode r (encodeSyntax (cleanup s))`, inside `staticCode`, inside `rowBound`, for all
three order tests (`signedSign` in the proof module).

## Failed routes (turn 002)

None. No gate failed this turn.

## 2026-11-22T21:57Z — read `opusB/S4-SURVEY.md` (it appeared after my own check)

Two points in it bear on my modules; I agree with both and have not acted on either:

1. **`properClauses` in `StageCallbackSupplier.packets`.** `Emits` is a literal list equation, so a raw
   `high` has to reproduce the proper-clause filter, and the operand half (`ProperField` on ordinal
   notations) has no code-level decider. Dropping the filter from `packets` is *not* free for the
   canonical supplier: canonical grouping discards zero-weight and cancelled occurrences, so a row
   with an improper operand of total weight zero would get packets that can hold although the
   literal row has no value. The filter (or an equivalent raw properness test) is therefore the
   availability check for discarded occurrences, and S4 needs the raw decider. `opusB/` now has a
   `RAW-PROPER-CLAUSE-SOURCE-MAP.md`, so this seems to be in hand there; I have not read it.
2. **Everything after the supplier is typed-computable and order-free**, with code-level programs
   only for the projection kernel, the charts, ranking, names and the stage bound. Consistent with my
   own minimal check above.

## State and next (end of turn 002)

**Gated this turn:** `STAGE-CALLBACK-CANONICAL-ROUTES` and `STAGE-CALLBACK-CANONICAL-SUPPLIER`.
Together with turn 001 this gives, for both controls (any `SelectedWithThreshold f B`):

    Emits canonical B high  ⟹  HighAtStage f B high (stageChildren canonical B)

with `canonical` built only from first-occurrence (`groupTyped`) syntax. Handoff items (a), (b), (c)
are done at the typed level: per-row guards characterise genuine successful reads and the requested
polarity (signed order/equality by the canonical routes, congruence by the accepted packet, ordered
availability by the proper-clause filter plus the paid read ceiling); the join is at one shared
greatest value with one tied table; both callback directions hold at the executable stage bound.

**What is still open — exactly one obligation:** a computable `high` with `Emits alt B high` for a
supplier `alt` that is exact. Nothing gated so far constructs a raw program. Two sub-points:

- *Order.* `canonical` lists a signed row's alternatives in depth-first tree order. A raw program
  built by iterating a level step will produce level order. `SupplierShape`/`SupplierExact` use
  membership only, so the fix is a second supplier `canonicalLevel` whose list is defined by the same
  level iteration the raw program runs, plus one lemma "same members as `routes`"; exactness then
  follows from the gated theorems without redoing any semantics. This should be designed *together

# Fable-2 plan — Paper 17, from the supporting results to the high callback contract

Written 2026-11-22 after reading the targets and proofs, not only the notes. Module names are under
`LogicLineages/PermittedControl/`; `X.y` means declaration `y` in namespace
`LogicLineages.PermittedControl.X`.

## Where the gap actually is

The decision theorem is `OriginalPrintedRawSelectedStageQuery.ForControl` (#1372): for every
`high : HighProgram` and `children : TypedHigh` with `OriginalPrintedRawStageQuery.HighAtStage f B
high children`, the raw query is correct, and it is computable when `high` is. So what is owed is

    ∃ high children, HighAtStage f B high children ∧ Computable high.

`HighAtStage` has three clauses per family `fs` of positive dimension, at `C = stageBound B
(encodeFamily fs)`: (1) `high (C, encodeFamily fs) = (children fs).map encodeFamily`; (2) every child
has smaller dimension; (3) `(∃ ρ, AllPaid C fs ρ ∧ Holds f ρ fs) ↔ ∃ ch ∈ children fs, Satisfiable f ch`.

Two things already exist and are easy to overlook:

- A typed, noncomputable compiler with clauses (2) and (3) at any `C ≥ cutoff`:
  `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.compile`, `exactAboveHighExistential`, `exactAboveHighDimension`
  (#1309), and `ActualRawStageCutoff.exactRawStageCutoffMajorant` (#1336) gives `cutoff ≤ stageBound`.
- Its proofs touch the packet list `OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh.highPackets` only through
  `highPacketShape` and `exactRankedLiteralHigh`; everything downstream
  (`ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection.prepend`, `ActualGreatestRouteResidual.lowerFamily`,
  `ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily.reifyFamily`, `ActualLowerRankChartRows.lowerChart`, the chart
  enumeration) is already generic in a `List Packet`.

So the semantic contract is not missing for the *old* list. What is missing is a list an executable
program can emit. The old one cannot be: `ActualBoundedSignedRoutes.routes` runs on
`normalizedTerms` / `nodePattern` / `successor`, whose order is the legacy `Finset` order (the
"old incidental syntax order" of the handoff). The canonical first-occurrence machinery (#1318–#1384)
is executable (`ActualRawCanonicalZeroPrefixes.prefixes`, `stepCode`, `candidateTapes`), but has only
one direction and no emitted guards.

A second, quieter gap: the canonical results are funded by `inputSignBoundCode ≤ ρ top`
(`ActualCanonicalFundedTerminal`), which is *larger* than the legacy
`terminalCutoffCeiling` (`ActualEffectiveTerminalSignBound.ExactSignBoundDominance` is an inequality
in that direction). The typed cutoff `ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh.cutoff` therefore does not obviously
fund the canonical route; the raw `stageBound` does, because `ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling.rowBound`
contains `staticCode = max commonCode signCode`. Any interface for the new compiler has to offer the
raw majorant, not the typed need.

## The chain

**S1 — generic contract over a per-row packet supplier (handoff items (b) and (c)).**
For any `alt : Nat → Nat → BitRow → List Packet` with shaped packets and row-level exactness under
the payments the stage bound provides (`SupplierExact`), the compiler built from `alt` by
Cartesian choice per proper clause, predecessor guard, projection at the shared greatest value,
decoding and reification satisfies clauses (2) and (3) of `HighAtStage` at `stageBound`, and hence
`HighAtStage` for every `high` meeting the literal emission equation.
Module `StageCallbackSupplierTargets` (`ExactSuppliedStageCallback` and five supporting targets).
Uses: `ActualSignedRouteCartesian.exactCartesianPacketEval` (one shared `z`, one tied table per
tuple), `OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge.exactLiteralProperClauseFilter` / `properClauseMember`,
`ActualSymbolicPredecessorProjection.exactSymbolicPredecessorAppend` / `…Projection`,
`ActualGreatestRouteResidual.exactActualLowerRouteFamily`,
`ActualGuardedResidualBitFamily.exactGuardedResidualUnion`,
`ActualLowerRankChartRows.exactLowerRankChartRows`, `ActualBitFamilyHigh.exactGenericRankTransport` /
`sourceCoordinate`, `ActualNamedBitFamilyHigh.exactNamedCharts` / `renameIndex` / `checkedLength`,
`ActualFiniteOrderBranches.exactActualBranchCoverage` / `exactPatternEnumeration` /
`exactBranchRealization`, `ActualRankChartPrototype.exactChartConsistency`,
`ActualRawStageCutoff.exactRawStageNamesAndCharts`, `ActualBitFamilyRawRank.exactRawRankCalibration`.
No selection hypothesis is needed in S1 itself; `SupplierExact f B alt` carries all of it.
**Attempt first.**

**S2 — the interface is inhabited and loses nothing.** The legacy
`fun r top row => ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples.alternatives r top (compileRow row)` is a shaped exact
supplier for every selected control, its packet list is literally `highPackets`, and its compile is
literally `ActualNamedBitFamilyHighAbove.compile`. Module `StageCallbackLegacyTargets`.
Uses `ActualPaidMixedMatrixTuples.alternativesShape` / `exactPaidMixedRow` / `exactMixedMatrixMinimum`,
`OriginalPrintedLiteralRowBridge.exactLiteralMixedRowBridge`,
`OriginalRankedLiteralClauseHigh.exactOriginalLiteralReady` on the one-row family,
`ActualRawMixedFamilyCeiling.exactRowBound`. This is a check on S1's hypotheses (that they are not
too strong to meet), not progress toward computability. **Attempt second.**

After S1 the remaining work is exactly two obligations, and they are independent:

**S3 — a canonical executable supplier that is exact (handoff item (a)).** Per signed row, the typed
shadow of the raw candidate list: for each `entry ∈ prefixes (syntaxBudgetCode r start.2) start`,
the packet `guards ++ terminal`, where the guard at each step is
`ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.compile top (pairs (labels terms)) a` on the canonical label order and
the terminal is `ActualCanonicalTerminalTruth.canonicalPacket` (inactive) or the constant truth
value of `signedBit test (maximalCoefficient terms a)` (nonzero). Sub-statements, in order:

- S3a *guard exactness on the canonical order*: under the row payments, `PacketHolds` of the
  compiled guard at `z` iff `Matches f (update baseline top z) (pairs (labels terms)) a`, with a tied
  table always existing. Supplier: `ActualFiniteFullValueGuards.exactFiniteFullValueGuards`
  (already order-parametric in the label list). Missing: `ReadyFamily` / `PaidFamily` for the
  canonical labels of every *reached* state from the row's raw bound — the canonical analogue of
  `ActualGlobalComparisonCeiling.PaidComparisonCeiling`; #1378 has it along one genuine trace.
- S3b *completeness*: a true row has a candidate whose every guard and terminal hold. This is #1384
  (`ActualRawFundedTerminalCandidate.ExactRawFundedTerminalCandidate`) plus S3a at each step of that
  very trace. Needs the valuation `update baseline top z` extended to a `StrictMono` one
  (`ActualRankedNormalizationSyntax.extend`), since the canonical theorems ask `StrictMono ρ`.
- S3c *soundness*: a candidate whose guards all hold is the genuine trace. `Matches` is functional
  in the answer tape (each `ActualOutcome` is a trichotomy), so a holding guard pins the answer to
  the actual one; then `ActualCanonicalZeroTrace.exactCanonicalZeroWitness` and
  `ActualRawCanonicalZeroTraceInclusion.exactActualZeroCandidateEdge` identify the raw step with the
